Mishneh Torah, Levirate Marriage and Rel: Mi shekkiddesh achat mishshete achayot veen yadua e ze mehen kiddesh umet velo ach. echad choletz lishtehen kede lehattiran laacherim. hayu lo shene achin echad choletz leachat mehen battechilla vehashsheni meyabbem lashsheniyya al kol panim. im zo hi shekkiddesh achiv hare yibbem otah. veim enah eshet achiv hare nasa ishsha mishshear hannashim vaachotah shehayta eshet achiv kevar nechletza. aval lo yeyabbem haachat techilla shemma haacheret hi eshet achiv venimtza shennasa kerovat zekukato. kadmu shene haachim vechansu shete hayevamot en motziin otan miyyadan:

Shenayim shekkiddeshu shete achayot. ze eno yodea e zo kiddesh veze eno yodea e zo kiddesh. umetu shenehen. laze ach velaze ach. ze choletz lishtehen veze choletz lishtehen. laze ach echad velaze shenayim. hayechidi choletz lishtehen battechilla vehashshenayim echad choletz rishona vehashsheni meyabbem. veim kadmu vechansu en motziin miyyadan. vaafillu hayu kohanim shehachalitza shechalatz hayechidi missafek chalatz vehachalutza asura lechohen middivre sofrim uvisfek chalutza lo gazru:

Hayu laze shene achin velaze shene achin. achiv shel ze choletz leachat veachiv shel ze choletz laacheret. veachar kach haach hashsheni shel ze meyabbem chalutzato shel ze. vehaach hashsheni shel ze meyabbem chalutzato shel ze. kadmu shenehen vechaltzu lishtehen lo yeyabbemu shene haachin haacherim. ella echad choletz battechilla veachiv meyabbem lashsheniyya. veim kadmu vechansu en motziin miyyadan:

Haishsha shehayu lah banim vehayu lechallatah banim venitabbera haishsha venitabbera kallatah veyaldu shetehen bemachavoa achat venitarvu shene hayeladim vehigdilu hattaarovot venasu nashim umetu. ketzad hen nittarot. bene hakkalla choltzin lishtehen techilla velo meyabbemin shekkol achat mehen safek shehi eshet achiv vetihye mutteret lo, safek shehi eshet achi aviv vehi erva alav. aval bene hazzekena o choltzin o meyabbemin. sheim hi zo eshet achiv hare yibbemah. veim hi eshet ben achiv mutteret lehinnase lo shekkevar nechletza:

Metu habbanim hayeduim shel zekena veshel kallatah vahare bene hattaarovot kayyamin. bene hattaarovot linshe bene hazzekena choltzin velo meyabbemin shehi sefek eshet achi aviv shehi erva alav, sefek eshet achiv shehi mutteret leyabbemah. velinshe bene hakkalla echad choletz battechilla veechad meyabbem al kol panim. im ben hakkalla hu shechalatz techilla hare chalatz eshet achiv vehashsheni min hattaarovot hu ben hazzekena umuttar lo lissa eshet ben achiv achar shennechletza mivamah. veim ze shechalatz techilla hu ben hazzekena hare chalatz leeshet ben achiv velo asa kelum vehashsheni min hattaarovot hu ben hakkalla vahare yibbem eshet achiv:

Mi shello shahata achar mitat balah shelosha chodashim venisset veyalda veen yadua im ben tisha larishon im ben shiva laacharon. vehayu lah banim min harishon umin hashsheni. im met ze habben hassafek. bene harishon uvene hashsheni choltzin leishto velo meyabbemin. shekkol echad mehen sheyyavo leyabbem shemma eno achiv meaviv vahare hu achiv meimmo bevadday veeshet achiv meimmo asura alav leolam mishshum erva. vechen ze habben hassafek choletz linshotehen velo meyabbem:

Haya ben larishon uven lashsheni shello meishsha zo shennisset betoch zeman umet echad mehen. hare habben hassafek choletz leeshet ze shemmet o meyabbem. sheim achiv meaviv hu hare yibbem et ishto veim eno achiv meaviv hare en benehen achava kelal lefichach muttar lo lissa et ishto:

Met habben hassafek echad mishshene habbanim havvaddain choletz leishto techilla vehashsheni meyabbem al kol panim. im achiv hu hare yibbem et ishto. veim eno achiv vehu ben haav haacher hare nechletza meachi balah:
Mi shehalach balah limdina acheret veshama shemmet venisset veachar kach ba habbaal harishon umetu shenehen velaze achin velaze achin. echav shel ze veechav shel ze choltzin velo meyabbemin:

Chamesh nashim shehaya lechol achat mehen ben yadua venitabberu chamishtan veyaldu keechad bemachavoa achat chamishsha banim acherim venitarvu hayeladim vehigdilu hattaarovot venasu nashim umetu chamishsha haanashim venaflu chamesh hannashim lifne chamishsha habbanim havvaddain sheen echad mehen yodea e zo hi eshet achiv ketzad takkanatan. arba mehen choltzin leachat techilla vehachamishi yissa zo shennechletza arba chalitzot al kol panim:

Ketzad. im eshet achiv hi hare yibbem otah. veim enah eshet achiv hare hi eshet ach echad mearbaa vahare chaltzu lah arbatan techilla. vechen hashsheniyya choltzin lah arbaa vehaechad min haarbaa yihye ze shennasa harishona vehachamishi yissaenna. ad shennimtzeu habbanim hachamishsha nasu hechamesh nashim achar shennechletza kol achat mehen arba chalitzot:

Uleolam hizzaher bechol hassefekot hallalu beikkarim ellu. shekkol mi shennistappek lecha shemma bat chalitza hi leish ze o enah tzericha lachalitza mimmennu. enah nitteret lehinnase lezar ad sheyyachalotz lah oto haish. vechol mi sheyyistappek lecha shemma biatah asura al ish ze ben middivre tora ben middivre sofrim enah mityabbemet lo. vechol shennechletza chalitza meulla o nivala beila keshera huttera tzaratah lezar:

Veal derech zo tavin vetore bechol hassefekot sheyyeeru leinyan yibbum vachalitza shehare bearnu kol haikkarin shealehen tismoch veteda mi hu shecholetz umi hu shemmeyabbem umi hi happetura min hachalitza umin hayyibbum umi hi haruya leyabbem: seliku lehu hilchot yibbum vachalitza besiyyata dishmayya
Mishneh Torah, Virgin Maiden 1:
Mi sheppitta betula konsin oto mishkal chamishshim selaim shel kesef mezukkak vehu hannikra kenas. vechen im anas otah. ukenas ze mitzvat ase shel tora shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 29)</small> "venatan haish hashshochev immah laavi hannaara chamishshim kesef": 
Vee ze hu mefatte vee ze hu ones. mefatte lirtzonah. ones shebba aleha beal karchah. kol hannivelet bassade hare zo bechezkat anusa vedanin otah bedin anusa ad sheyyaidu haedim shebbirtzonah nivala. vechol hannivelet bair hare zo bechezkat mefutta mippene shello zaaka ad sheyyaidu haedim shehi anusa, kegon sheshshalaf lah cherev veamar lah im tizaki eherog otach: 
Hamefutta shello ratzta lehinnase lamfatte. o shello ratza aviha littenah lo. o shello ratza hu lichnos. hare ze noten kenas veholech veen kofin oto lichnos. veim ratzu uchenasah eno meshallem kenas ella kotev lah ketubba kishar habbetulot. aval haanusa shello ratzta hi o aviha lehinnase leones harshut beyadam venoten kenas veholech. ratzta hi veaviha velo ratza hu kofin oto vechones venoten kenas shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 29)</small> "velo tihye leishsha" hare zo mitzvat ase. afillu hi chiggeret o suma o metzoraat kofin oto lichnos veeno motzi lirtzono leolam shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 19)</small> "lo yuchal leshallechah kol yamav" hare zo mitzvat lo taase: 
Veen lah ketubba shello tikkenu chachamim ketubba leishsha ella kede shello tihye kalla beenav lehotziah veze eno yachol lehotziah: 
Hayta anusa zo asura alav afillu mechayyave ase vaafillu sheniyya hare ze lo yissaenna. vechen im nimtza bah devar zimma achar shekkanas hare ze yegarshenah shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 29)</small> "velo tihye leishsha". ishsha haruya lo: 
Kohen gadol sheanas betula o sheppitta otah hare ze lo yichnos mippene shehu metzuvve likkach et habbetula uveshaa sheyyissa zo enah betula. veim kanas yotzi beget: 
Af al pi shenneemar beones <small>(Devarim 22 19)</small> "lo yuchal leshallechah" kevan shekkedamo ase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 29)</small> "velo tihye leishsha" hare ze nitteko laase venimtzet zo mitzvat lo taase shennittekah laase sheen lokin aleha ella im lo kiyyem ase shebbah kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot sanhedrin. lefichach haones sheavar vegeresh kofin oto lehachazir veeno loke. meta gerushato kodem sheyyachzirenna o nitkaddesha leacher o shehaya kohen sheasur bigrusha hare ze loke shehare avar al lo taase veeno yachol lekayyem ase shebbah: 
En haones o hamefatte chayyav biknas ad sheyyavo aleha [kedarkah] uveedim veeno tzarich hateraa. umeematay yihye labbat kenas. meachar shalosh shanim gemurot ad shettivgor. nivala betoch shalosh shanim en biatah bia. ba aleha mishshebbagra en lah kenas shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 28)</small> "naara vetula" lo habbogeret: 
Veachat sheyyesh lah av veachat sheen lah av yesh lah kenas. veellu sheen lahen kenas. habbogeret vehamemaenet vehaaylonit vehashshota vehachereshet. umi sheyyatza aleha shem ra beyaldutah uvau shenayim veheidu shettava otan liznot immah. vehamegoreshet min hannissuin vaadayin hi naara betula. aval hamegoreshet min haerusin im neensa yesh lah kenas ukenasah leatzmah. veim nitpatteta en lah kenas: 
Haggiyyoret vehashshevuya vehameshuchreret im nitgayyera venifdet venishtachrera vehi bat shalosh shanim o pachot yesh lah kenas. veim hayta bat shalosh shanim veyom echad keshennitgayyera o keshennifdet o keshennishtachrera en lah kenas hoil uviatan bia hare hen kivulot: 
Hayta betula zo asura al haones o hamefatte im hayta achat mechayyave keretot kegon achoto o dodato vehannidda vechayyotze bahen o shehayta mechayyave lavin im hitru bo hare ze loke veeno meshallem kenas sheen adam loke umeshallem. veim lo hayta sham hateraa hoil veeno chayyav malkot hare ze meshallem kenas: 
Hayta mechayyave ase o sheniyya vechayyotze bahen sheasura middivre sofrim. ben hitru bo ben lo hitru bo chayyav biknas sheen kan malkot: 
Hayta mechayyave mitat bet din kegon bitto veeshet beno vechayyotze bahen ben hitru bo ben lo hitru bo patur min hakkenas shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 22)</small> "velo yihye ason anosh yeanesh" ha im haya sham ason en sham onesh. veaf al pi sheharigat haishsha bishgaga shehare lo nitkavvenu lah shenneemar <small>(Shemot 21 22)</small> "ki yinnatzu anashim venagfu ishsha" ha lamadta shello chillek hakkatuv beason ben shogeg lemezid lefatro min hattashlumin. vahare hu omer <small>(Vayikra 24 18)</small> "makke nefesh behema yeshallemenna" <small>(Vayikra 24 21)</small> "umakke adam yumat" ma makke nefesh behema lo chillek hakkatuv ben shogeg lemezid lechayyevo betashlumin af makke nefesh adam lo chillek hakkatuv ben shogeg lemezid lefatro min hattashlumin: 
Vechen haddin lechol avera sheyyesh bah mitat bet din sheen bah tashlumin: 
Ba aleha umeta hare ze patur min hakkenas shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 29)</small> "venatan haish hashshochev immah laavi hannaara" lo laavi hammeta. vehu shettamut kodem shettaamod baddin:
Mishneh Torah, Virgin Maiden 2:
Chamishim kesef shel kenas hem deme hanaat shechiva bilvad. vechayyav hamefatte litten boshet ufegam yoter al hakkenas hakkatzuv battora. yeter alav haones shehu noten et hatztzaar. shehannivelet birtzonah en lah tzaar vaanusa yesh lah tzaar. vechen hu omer baanusa <small>(Devarim 22 29)</small> "tachat asher innah": 
Nimtza hamefatte meshallem shelosha devarim kenas uvoshet ufegam. vehaones arbaa kenas uvoshet vetzaar ufegam: 
Kenas shave bakkol. echad habba al bat kohen gadol veechad habba al bat ger o mamzer kenasah chamishshim kesef. aval habboshet vehappegam vehatztzaar enan shavin lakkol utzerichin shuma: 
Ketzad shamin habboshet. hakkol lefi hamevayyesh vehammitbayyesh. sheeno dome mevayyesh naara chashuva umimmishpacha meyuchasa limvayyesh ketanna aniyya bezuya. veeno dome mitbayyesh meadam chashuv vegadol lemitbayyesh meechad mehannevalim vekal min hakkallim: 
Ulefi ze roin haddayyanin maalato umaalatah veshamin kamma mamon rauy leaviha ulemishpachtah litten velo yeera lahen davar ze meadam ze vechamohu chayyav leshallem: 
Pegam lefi yafyah. roin otah keillu hi shifcha nimkeret bashshuk kamma hi shava beula vechamma hayta shava betula. sheadam rotze liknot shifcha betula littenah leavdo shehu rotze bahanayato vetovato. veroin kamma pachata vishallem tzaar lefi katnutah uvinyan gufah. ulefi shanav vegufo omdin kamma haav rotze litten velo titztaer zo mizze veyitten: 
Hamefatte noten boshet ufegam miyyad veeno noten hakkenas ella im ken lo nesaah shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 16)</small> "veim maen yemaen aviha letittah lo kesef yishkl". aval haones noten arbaa devarim miyyad vechones. lefichach keshettirtze lehitgaresh o titalmen en lah kelum: 
Bau aleha shenayim echad kedarkah veechad shello kedarkah ze shebba aleha shello kedarkah im hu rishon chayyav bevoshet ufegam veim hu acharon chayyav bevoshet bilvad shekkevar nifgema. veze shebba aleha kedarkah ben rishon ben acharon chayyav biknas uvishar haddevarim. aval en boshet ufegam shel bat shello nivala kelal kevoshet ufegam zo shennivala shello kedarkah: 
Kevar hodanu habbanot sheen lahen kenas veeser hen. habbogeret. vehamemaenet. vehamegoreshet. vehaaylonit. vehashshota. vehachereshet. vehaggiyyoret. vehashshevuya. vehameshuchreret. vehayyotze aleha shem ra. ushear habbanot yesh lahen kenas: 
Kol bat sheyyesh lah kenas yesh lah boshet ufegam. veim hayta anusa yesh lah tzaar. vechol bat sheen lah kenas kach en lah lo boshet velo pegam im nitpatteta vechen im neensa chutz mibbogeret umemaenet veshota vechereshet: 
Ketzad. haones et habbogeret veet hamemaenet af al pi sheen lahen kenas yesh lahen boshet ufegam vetzaar. vehaones shota o chereshet meshallem tzaar bilvad. aval hamefatte et kullan patur mikkelum: 
En adam meshallem kenas bechol makom behodaat piv ella al pi edim. lefichach haomer anasti o pittiti bitto shel peloni eno meshallem kenas aval meshallem boshet ufegam behodaat piv. vechen bat shettava ish baddin veamra lo anasta o pittita oti vehu omer lo hayu devarim meolam hare ze nishba shevuat hesset sheillu hoda haya meshallem lah boshet ufegam vetzaar al pi atzmo: 
Amra lo anasta oti vehu omer lo ki ella pittiti hare ze nishba shevuat hattora al deme hatztzaar umeshallem boshet ufegam shehare hoda bemiktzat hattaana kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo: 
Shelosha devarim shel mefatte vearbaa shel ones hare hen shel av shekkol shevach neurim lo. veim en lah av hare hen shel atzmah: 
Mefutta o anusa shello tava ad shebbagra o ad shennisset o ad shemmet haav haarbaa devarim o hashshelosha shellah. amda baddin vetava oto veachar kach bagra o shennisset hare hen shel av. veim met haav achar amidatah baddin hare hen shel achin shehen yorshe haav. shemmeet sheamda bedin zacha bahen haav: 
Habbat shennitarsa venitgarsha kenasah levaddo leatzmah. neensa o nitpatteta veachar kach nitkaddesha leacher kenasah ushear haddevarim leaviha. sheen haerusin motziin mershut av: 
Ani omer shezze shenneemar battora <small>(Vayikra 19 29)</small> "al techallel et bittecha lehazenotah". shello yomar haav hoil velo chiyyeva tora mefatte veones ella sheyyitten mamon laav hareni socher bitti habbetula laze lavo aleha bechol mamon sheertze o aniach ze lavo aleha bechinnam sheyyesh lo laadam limchol mamono lechol mi sheyyirtze lechach neemar al techallel et bittecha. shezze shechiyyeva tora laones velamfatte mamon velo malkot besheera haddavar mikre shello middaat aviha velo hechina atzmah lechach sheddavar ze eno hove tamid veeno matzuy. aval im heniach bitto habbetula muchenet lechol mi sheyyavo aleha gorem shettimmale haaretz zimma venimtza haav nose bitto vehaach nose achoto sheim titabber veteled lo yivvada ben mi hu. vehammechin bitto lechach hare hi kedesha veloke habboel vehannivelet mishshum <small>(Devarim 23 18)</small> "lo tihye kedesha". veen konsin oto shello chiyyeva tora kenas ella leones umefatte aval zo shehechina atzmah lechach ben middatah ben middaat aviha hare zo kedesha. veissur kedesha echad hu ben bivtula ben bivula lefichach amru chachamim shehayyotze aleha shem ra beyaldutah en lah kenas kemo shebbearnu shehare zo bechezkat shehifkira atzmah ledavar ze birtzonah:
Mishneh Torah, Virgin Maiden 3: Hammotzi shem ra al bat yisrael venimtza haddavar sheker loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 18)</small> "veyisseru oto". veazhara shello mi<small>(Vayikra 19 16)</small> "lo telech rachil beammecha". venoten leaviha mishkal mea selaim kesef mezukkak. veim hayta yetoma hare hem shel atzmah:

Vehammotzi shem ra al hakketanna o al habbogeret patur min hakkenas umin hammalkot. veeno chayyav ad sheyyotzi al hannaara shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 15)</small> "vehotziu et betule hannaara" naara male dibber hakkatuv:

En danin din ze ella bifne habbayit uvet din shel esrim ushelosha. mippene sheyyesh bedin motzi shem ra dine nefashot. sheim nimtza haddavar kemo shenneemar hare zo nehereget. aval haones vehamefatte danin bahen bechol zeman bishlosha kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot sanhedrin:

Umitzvat ase shel tora shetteshev eshet motzi shem ra tachtav leolam shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 19)</small> "velo tihye leishsha" afillu ivveret o mukkat shechin. veim gershah avar al lo taase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 19)</small> "lo yuchal leshallechah kol yamav". vechofin oto umachazir veeno loke kemo shebbearnu beones. veim kiddem echad vekiddeshah o shemmeta o shehaya kohen sheasur bigrusha hare ze loke al gerusheha:

Nimtza bah devar zimma. o shennimtzet asura alav mechayyave lavin o mechayyave ase vaafillu sheniyya hare ze yegarshenna beget shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 19)</small> "velo tihye leishsha" ishsha haruya lo. velamma lo yavo ase veyidche et lo taase ben bemotzi shem ra ben beones veyissa zo haasura lo. shehare efshar shello tirtze hi leshev venimtza ase velo taase kayyamin:

Ketzad hotzaat shem ra. hu sheyyavo levet din veyomar naara zo baalti velo matzati lah betulim ucheshebbikkashti al haddavar noda li shezzinneta tachtay achar sheerastiha veellu hem eday shezzinneta bifnehem. uvet din shomin divre haedim vechokrin edutan. im nimtza haddavar emet niskelet. veim hevi haav edim vehuzemu haedim shehevi habbaal venimtza sheheidu sheker yissaklu veyilke hu venoten mea selaim. veal ze neemar <small>(Devarim 22 17)</small> "veelle betule vitti", ellu haedim sheyyazimu ede habbaal. chazar habbaal vehevi edim acherim vehezimu ede haav hare hannaara veede aviha niskalin. al ze neemar <small>(Devarim 22 20)</small> "veim emet haya haddavar hazze". mippi hashshemua lamdu shepparasha zo yesh bah edim vezommin vezomme zommin:

Hotzi aleha shem ra vehi bogeret af al pi shehevi edim shezzinneta tachtav keshehayta naara hare ze patur min hammalkot umin hakkenas. veim nimtza haddavar emet hare zo tissakel af al pi shehi bogeret hoil uveet shezzinneta naara hayta:

Kol naara sheen lah kenas im neensa o nitpatteta kach hammotzi aleha shem ra patur min hammalkot umin hattashlumin. vechen hakkutit shennitgayyera vehashshifcha shennishtachrera pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim afillu hayta horatah shello bikdushsha veledatah bikdushsha hammotzi aleha shem ra patur min hakkenas umin hammalkot shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 19)</small> "ki hotzi shem ra al betulat yisrael" ad shettihye horatah veledatah bikdushsha:

Kiddesh naara vegershah vechazar vekiddeshah vehotzi aleha shem ra vehevi edim shezzinneta tachtav bakkiddushin harishonim venimtzeu zommim hare ze patur. vechen im hayta yevimto shekkansah vehotzi aleha shem ra vehevi edim shezzinneta tachat kiddushe achiv venimtzeu zommim hare ze patur min hammalkot umin hattashlumin. vechol happatur im ratza legaresh yegaresh:
Eno chayyav ad sheyyivol otah kedarkah veyotzi shem ra (al habbeila) kedarkah. bealah shello kedarkah veamar lo metzatiha betula patur umakkin oto makkat mardut:
Vechen im amar lo metzatiha betula velo amar shezzinneta tachtay o sheamar zinneta tachtay velo hevi edim ella bau mealehem hare ze patur af al pi shehaedim neheragim im huzammu:

Ze shenneemar battora <small>(Devarim 22 17)</small> "ufarsu hassimla" leshon kavod shennosin venotnin besitre haddavar. vechen ze sheyyomar haav <small>(Devarim 22 17)</small> "elle betule vitti" hen zomme ede habbaal. veze shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 20)</small> "veim emet haya haddavar" tehareg keshezzinneta achar haerusin beedim shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 21)</small> "liznot bet aviha". aval kodem haerusin kevar amra tora bah shehi petura mikkelum uvoalah chayyav betashlume mamon bilvad ben pitta ben anas:
Mishneh Torah, Woman Suspected of Infide:
Kinnuy haamur battora <small>(Bamidbar 5 14)</small> "vekinne et ishto" hu sheyyomar lah bifne edim al tissatri im ish peloni. afillu haya aviha o achiha o akkum o eved o shachuf hu haish sheeno mitkashshe veeno molid: 
Hassetira haamura battora <small>(Bamidbar 5 13)</small> "venistera" hu shettissater im oto haish sheamar lah al tissatri immo bifne shene edim. im shahata immo kede tuma shehu kede litzlot betza ulegamah hare zo asura al balah ad shettishte me hammarim veyibbadek haddavar. uvizman sheen sham me sota teaser alav leolam vetetze belo ketubba: 
Kinne lah al shenayim keechad veamar lah al tissatri im peloni ufeloni. venistera im shenehen keechad veshahata kede tuma. afillu hem shene acheha o aviha veachiha hare zo asura ad shettishte: 
Amar lah bifne shenayim al tedabberi im peloni en ze kinnuy. veaf al pi shennistera immo beedim veshahata kede tuma lo neesra alav veenah shota bekinnuy ze: 
Vechen im amar lah al tissatri immo verauha medabberet immo en zo setira. velo neesra velo shota. vechen im lo kadam kinnuy uvau shenayim veheidu shennistera im ze veshahata kede tuma lo neesra al balah veenah shota: 
Amar lah lo tissatri im ish peloni vehaya katan pachot mibben tesha shanim veyom echad. o sheamar lah al tissatri im behema zo en ze kinnuy shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 13)</small> "veshachav ish otah" perat lekatan velivhema sheen osrin otah alav: 
Baal shemmachal al kinnuyo kodem shettissater kinnuyo machul ucheillu lo kinne lah meolam. aval im machal achar shettissater eno yachol limchol. gershah hare ze kemi shemmachal veim hechezirah tzarich lekanneot kinnuy acher: 
Kinne lah bifne shenayim veraa otah shennistera im ze shekkinne lah alav veshahata kede tuma hare zo asura alav veyotzi veyitten ketubba. sheeno yachol lehashekotah al pi atzmo. vechen im shama haam merannenin achareha achar hakkinnuy vehassetira ad sheshshama mehannashim hattovot leor hallevana nosot venotnot bah shezzinneta im haish shekkinne lah alav hare ze asur lekayyemah veyotzi veyitten ketubba: 
Ba ed echad veheid lo shennistera immo achar kinnuy veshahata kede tuma. im hu neeman lo vedato somechet alav yotzi veyitten ketubba. veim lav hare ishto mutteret lo: 
Veellu shebbet din mekannin lahen. mi shennitcharesh balah o shennishtatta o shehaya bimdina acheret o shehaya chavush bevet haasurin. lo lehashekotah ella lefaslah mikketubbatah: 
Ketzad. shamu bet din shehaam merannenin achareha. korin otah veomrin lah al tissatri im ish peloni. bau edim achar kach shennistera immo veshahata kede tuma bet din osrin otah al balah leolam vekorin ketubbatah. uchesheyyavo balah o yavri o yatza mibbet haasurin noten lah get. veeno yachol lehashekotah mippene shello kinne lah hu: 
Shatat me hammarim venikketa mehen vechazar vekinne lah im haish shehishka al yado venistera immo eno yachol lehashekotah al yado paam sheniyya ella teaser alav leolam vetetze belo ketubba. aval im kinne lah im acher venistera im haacher beedim mashkin otah paam sheniyya vaafillu kamma peamim. vehu sheyyashke otah bechol paam biglal ish acher: 
Hishka otah vegershah venisset leacher vekinne lah im haish shehishka otah habbaal harishon biglalo venistera immo beedim. hare habbaal hashsheni mashke otah al yado mippene shehu baal sheni. vaafillu mea venisset leze achar ze mashkin otah al yede ish echad. veen omrin vadday shehuchzeka laze utemea ad sheyyihye sham ed: 
Haishsha shekkinne lah balah venistera achar hakkinnuy immo beedim vahare hi omedet lishtot uva ed echad veheid aleha shennivala befanav im ze shekkinne lah immo hare ze asura al balah leolam. veenah shota veyotzet belo ketubba. vaafillu haya ed tuma ze echad meede hassetira shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 13)</small> "veed en bah" vahare kan ed: 
Afillu ishsha veeved veshifcha ufasul leedut baavera middivre sofrim vaafillu karov neeman leedut sota lehaid aleha shezzinneta veteaser al balah leolam. veenah shota vetetze belo ketubba. hoil vekadam hakkinnuy vehassetira beedim kesherim vehattora heemina ed echad betuma hare kullan kesherin leedut tuma. af chamesh nashim shessonot zo et zo meidot zo al zo lomar shennitmet. veneemenet aleha leasrah al balah veshello lehashekotah. aval lo lehafesidah mikketubbatah. ella notelet ketubbatah veyotza: 
Ba ed echad kasher veamar nitmet hare zo enah shota kemo shebbearnu. ba ed echad vehichchisho veamar lo nitmet en shomin lo. sheed echad betumat sota kishnayim. veen devarav shel acharon dochin divre harishon shehu kishnayim: 
Bau shenehen keechad ze omer nitmet veze omer lo nitmet. o sheamar echad nitmet uvau shenayim acherim veamru lo nitmet hare zo shota: 
Ba ed echad kasher venashim rabbot o pesulin rabbim keechad. haed omer nitmet vehannashim o happesulin omrim lo nitmet hare zo shota. sheed echad ufesulin rabbim kemechetza al mechetza hem: 
Hayu kullan pesulin hallech achar harov. ketzad. shete nashim omrot nitmet veshalosh omrot lo nitmet hare zo shota. shalosh omrot lo nitmet vearba omrot nitmet hare zo enah shota. hayu mechetza al mechetza hare zo shota: 
Kol sota sheamarnu sheenah shota mippene ede tuma hare zo asura al balah leolam vetetze belo ketubba shehare neesra bekinnuy usetira. vehashshetiyya shettattirah nimnea shehare yesh bah ed kemo shebbearnu:

Isha shekkinne lah venistera en kofin otah lishtot. ella im ratzta veamra hen nitmeti tetze belo ketubba veneesra al balah leolam veenah shota. vechen im amra eni temea veeni shota en kofin otah lishtot vetetze belo ketubba. vechen im amar balah eni rotze lehashekotah o shebbealah balah achar shennistera hare zo enah shota venotelet ketubbatah veyotza vehi asura [alav] leolam: 
Veellu hen hannashim sheenan reuyot lishtot af al pi shehen rotzot lishtot uvalehen rotzim lehashekotan ella yotzot belo ketubba mishsheyyavou ede setira achar ede kinnuy veyeasru al balehen leolam. vachamesh esre nashim hen. veellu hen. arusa. veshomeret yavam. uketanna eshet haggadol. ugedola eshet hakkatan. veeshet anderoginus. veeshet hassuma. veeshet hachigger o haillem. o mi sheeno shomea. o shehu kerut yad. vechen hachiggeret. vehaillemet. vehassuma. ucherutat yad. vesheenah shomaat. kol achat meellu enah reuya lishtot: 
Uminnayin sheenah reuya lishtot shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 29)</small> "asher tiste ishsha tachat ishah". tachat perat laarusa veshomeret yavam sheenah tachat ishah. ishsha perat liktanna. tachat ishah perat leeshet katan veeshet anderoginus sheeno ish. <small>(Bamidbar 5 13)</small> "veneelam meene ishah" perat leeshet suma. <small>(Bamidbar 5 18)</small> "veheemid hakkohen et haishsha" perat lechiggeret. <small>(Bamidbar 5 18)</small> "venatan al kappeha" perat lemi sheen lah kaf o shehayta akumma o yevesha sheenah yechola likkach bah. vaafillu kappah achat shenneemar kappeha. veamra haishsha perat leillemet. <small>(Bamidbar 5 19)</small> "veamar el haishsha" perat lemi sheenah shomaat. vahare hu omer asher tiste ishsha tachat ishah ad shettihye shelema kamohu vehu shalem kemotah. ha lamadta shekkol davar shemmeakkev otah millishtot meakkev et balah millehashkotah. vechol hameakkev et habbaal millehashkotah mum kamohu meakkev otah millishtot: 
Ketanna shehissiah aviha im zinneta birtzonah neesra al balah. lefichach mekannin lah lo lehashekotah ella lefaslah mikketubbatah kemo sheamarnu. aval ketanna bat meun en mekannin lah sheen lah ratzon leheaser al balah. vaafillu haya kohen lo neesra alav: 
Kinne laarusato o lizkukato venistera achar shennissea hare zo shota kishar kol hannashim. nesua shekkinne lah venistera kodem sheyyivol otah balah enah shota veyotza belo ketubba vaasura alav leolam shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 20)</small> "vayyitten ish bach et shechavto mibbalade ishech" shekkadma shechivat baal lishchivat boel: 
Haggiyyoret vehameshuchreret veeshet hagger veeshet eved meshuchrar umamzeret veeshet mamzer veeshet seris chamma o seris adam hammuttarot levalehen hare hen kechol hannashim veshotot: 
Meubberet umenika mekanne lah umashke otah kemot shehi. ishsha haomedet lishtot umet balah kodem shettishte enah shota velo notelet ketubbatah: 
Kol ish shebba bia asura miyyamav achar shehigdil en hammayim hamearrim bodkin et ishto. vaafillu ba al arusato bevet chamiv sheasur middivre sofrim en hammayim bodkin et ishto shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 lo)</small> "venikka haish meavon vehaishsha hahi tissa et avonah". bizman shehaish menukke meavon ishsha nosa et avonah: 
Lefichach im hayta ishto asura alav mechayyave lavin o mechayyave ase afillu sheniyya vekinne lah venistera enah shota ella tetze belo ketubba vetihye asura alav af mishshum ze. avar venasa meubberet chavero umeneket chavero hare zo shota sheen kan avera: 
Mi sheen lo ishsha haruya leled velo banim venasa akara o zekena o aylonit enah shota velo notelet ketubba. hayu lo banim o ishsha acheret reuya leled hare ze mashke otah af al pi shehi zekena o akara o aylonit veenah reuya leled shello neemar battora <small>(Bamidbar 5 28)</small> "venizrea zara" ella biruya leled sheim hayta yoledet betzaar teled berevach. haya darkah leled nekevot teled zecharim: 
Hayu lo ishsha uvanim umetu ben kinnuy listira kevar niret lishtot umashke otah. lo hayu lo banim velo ishsha haruya leled ella zo haaylonit vechayyotze bah venolad lo ben miggerushato ben kinnuy listira kevar nidchet haaylonit millishtot: 
Kol ishsha shehaya lah kinnuy usetira velo shatta me hammarim ben shello ratza balah lehashekotah ben shello ratzta hi uven shebba lah ed tuma o hodet o hayta meellu hannashim sheenan reuyot lishtot o shekkinneu lah bet din. hoil veneesra al balah mikkol makom hare hi asura al ze shennityachada immo leolam kederech shehi asura al balah. veim avar unesaah motziin otah mittachtav beget afillu hayu lah kamma banim mimmennu. mippi hashshemua lamdu keshem sheasura labbaal kach asura labboel: 
Aval im lo kadam kinnuy uvau aleha edim shennistera im ish ze uvau umatzu davar mechoar kegon shennichnesu acharav umetzauha chogeret chagora. o matzu rok lemala min hakkila vechayyotze baze. im hotziah balah bedavar mechoar kaze hare zo lo tinnase lannitan ella asura alav. veim avar unesaah vehayu lah banim mimmennu lo tetze. veim lo hayu lah banim mimmennu tetze: 
Bamme devarim amurim besherinnenu hair aleha veal hannitan yom umechetza o yoter. veamru peloni zinna im pelonit velo pasak hakkol. vehu shello hayu lah o lo oyvim shemmaavirin et hakkol. aval im lo hayta sham rinna ledavar ze bair o sheppasak hakkol shello mechamat yira. im nisset lannitan lo tetze af al pi sheen lah banim. afillu ba ed echad shezzinneta immo lo tetze: 
Mi shehotziah balah beede davar mechoar venisset leacher vegershah hare zo asura lehinnase lannitan sheyyatzata mittachat balah biglalo. veim nisset lo tetze af al pi sheen lah banim: 
Kol ishsha shebbau shene edim veheidu shezzinneta im ze keshehayta tachat balah harishon hare zo tetze mizze. veaf al pi sheyyesh lah mimmennu kamma banim. vechol makom sheamarnu tetze tetze belo ketubba:

Ketzad seder hashekaat sota. habbaal ba levet din shebbeiro veomer lahen ishti zo kinneti lah im peloni venistera immo veellu hen eday vahare hi omeret shehi tehora vaani rotze lehashekotah livdok haddavar. uvet din shomin divre haedim. umosrin lo shene talmide chachamim leshamro shemma yavo aleha kodem shetiyya. shehare neesra alav ad shettishte. umeshallechin oto lirushalayim sheen mashkin et hassota ella bevet din haggadol shel shivim zekenim bammikdash: 
Higgiu lirushalayim bet din haggadol moshivin otah benehen umeayyemin aleha shello bifne balah umafchidin otah pachad gadol shello tishte. veomrim lah bitti harebe hayyayin ose. harebe sechok ose. harebe yaldut osa. harebe shechenim raim osim. al tigremi lashshem haggadol shennichtav bikdushsha sheyyimmache al hammayim. veomrin lah bitti harebe kedamuch venishtefu vaanashim gedolim vikarim takaf yitzran alehen venichshelu. umaggidin lah maase yehuda vetamar kallato. umaase reuven befilegesh aviv al peshato. umaase amnon vaachoto. kede lehakel aleha ad shettode. veim amra hen nitmeti o eni shota yotza belo ketubba veholechet lah: 
Amda bedibburah shehi tehora. meviin otah leshaar mizrachi shel azara shehu keneged kodesh hakkadashim. umaalin otah mimmakom lemakom umakkifin bah kede leyaggeah ad shettiktzar nafshah ulay tode: 
Im amda bedibburah meviin otah keneged shaar hammizrach mibbachutz umaamidin otah sham. hayta mitkassa bilvanim mitkassa bishchorin. veim hayu hashshechorin nain lah mitkassa bivgadim sheen lah bahen noy. umesirin kol kele kesef vezahav shealeha: 
Umekabbetzin aleha kibbutz gadol shel nashim shekkol hannashim hannimtzaot sham chayyavot lirotah shenneemar <small>(Yechezkel 23 48)</small> "venivvasseru kol hannashim velo taasena kezimmatchena". vechol ish sheyyachpotz lavo lirotah yavo veyire. vehi omedet benehen belo redid uvelo mitpachat ella bivgadeha vechippa sheal roshah kemo shehaishsha betoch betah: 
Veen mannichin sham lo avadeha velo shifchoteha mippene shehi makkeret otan vedatah mityashshevet bahen: 
Veachar kach mashbiah hakkohen belashon shehi makkeret umodiah bilshonah shello garam lah ella kinnuy usetira shekkinne lah balah venistera. veomer lah belashon shemmakkeret <small>(Bamidbar 5 19)</small> "im lo shachav ish otach veim lo satit tuma tachat ishech hinnaki mimme hammarim hameararim haelle" <small>(Bamidbar 5 20)</small> "veat ki satit tachat ishech vechi nitmet vayyitten ish bach et shechavto mibbalade ishech" <small>(Bamidbar 5 21)</small> "yitten Adonai otach leala velishvua betoch ammech betet Adonai et yerechech nofelet veet bitnech tzava" <small>(Bamidbar 5 22)</small> "uvau hammayim hamearrim haelle bemeayich latzbot beten velanpil yarech". vehi omeret <small>(Bamidbar 5 22)</small> "amen amen" belashon shemmakkeret. umodiah shehabbeten hi tilke techilla vehayyarech bassof kede shello lehotzi laaz al hammayim: 
Veachar kach mevi megilla shel or tahor kemo sefer tora vechotev aleha bilshon hakkodesh bidyo sheen bo kankantom lishmah shel ishsha kemo hagget. vechotev kol haddevarim shehishbia otah bahem ot beot milla bemilla. vechotev et hashshem kichtavo. veeno kotev amen amen: 
Veachar kach mevi keli cheres shello naasa bo melacha meolam velo yerae kichli bale meorech hazzeman. veim hechziro lakkivshan ad shennitchaddesh kasher. venoten letocho chatzi log mayim min hakkiyyor. uvachatzi log shehaya bammikdash haya moddo. venichnas bo lahechol: 
Umakom haya sham amma al amma limin hannichnas uvo tavla shel shayish vetabbaat kevua bah. magbiah hattavla velokeach afar mikkarka hammishkan. venotno al gabbe hammayim kede sheyyerae al pene hammayim. venoten letochan davar mar kegon laana vechayyotze bah shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 18)</small> "me hammarim". umochek letochan hammegilla lishmah veyimchok yafe yafe ad shello yishshaer bammegilla roshem hannikkar kelal: 
Veachar kach kohen echad ba eleha mikkohane haazara veochez bivgadeha mikkeneged paneha vekorea ad shehu megalle et libbah. umegalle searah vesoter machlefot roshah kede lenavvelah. umevi chevel mitzri kede lehazekirah maase mitzrayim sheasta. veim lo matzu mitzri mevi chevel mikkol makom. vekoshro lemala middadeha kede shello yippelu habbegadim venimtzet arumma shehare nikreu: 
Veachar kach mevi issaron kemach seorim mishshel baal. venotno bichfifa mitzrit. vehachevel vehakkefifa bain mishsheyare hallishka. venotno leyadeha kede leyaggeah: 
Veachar kach lokeach hammincha min hakkefifa venotnah lichli sharet. veeno noten aleha shemen velo levona. veim natan loke al hashshemen bifne atzmo veal hallevona bifne atzmah. shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 15)</small> "lo yitzok aleha shemen velo yitten aleha levona": 
Uvechol zeman shepporea roshah venoten haissaron al yadeha yihyu hammayim bichli beyad hakkohen veyare otah et hammayim shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 18)</small> "uveyad hakkohen yihyu me hammarim hameararim": 
Veachar kach mashke otah. veachar shettishte lokeach keli sharet shebbo hammincha venotno al yadeha. vechohen meniach yado tachteha umenifah bammizrach kishar kol hattenufot. molich umevi maale umorid. veachar kach maggish hammincha lekeren deromit maaravit shel mizbeach kishar menachot shel yachid. vekometz umaktir hakkometz. vehashshear neechol lakkohanim: 
Im tehora hi yotzet veholechet lah vahare hi mutteret levalah. veim temea hi miyyad paneha morikot veeneha boltot vehi mitmallet gidin gidin vehen omrin hotziuha (hotziuha) kede shello tifrosho nidda vehanniddot metammeot ezrat nashim. vehen motziin otah meezrat nashim shehi omedet bah. uvitnah tzava battechilla veachar kach tippol yerechah vetamut: 
Beotah shaa shettamut hi yamut hannoef shehishka al yado bechol makom shehu veyeeru lo meoraot sheeru lah <small>(Bamidbar 5 22)</small> "latzbot beten velanpil yarech". vechol ze im lo ba balah bia asura meolam. aval im baal beila shel issur en hammayim bodkin et ishto kemo shebbearnu: 
Veim avar vehishka et ishto hare ze mosif al chattato pesha sheggaram lashshem hameforash sheyyimmache bammayim levattala umotzi laaz al me sota sheishto omeret laacherot shezzinneta velo badku bah hammayim vehi lo teda shemmaase habbaal garmu shello badku bah: 
Lefichach mishsherabbu hamenaafim begaluy bevayit sheni bittelu hassanhedrin et me hammarim vesamchu al hakkatuv bakkabbala <small>(Hoshea 4 14)</small> "lo efkod al benotechem ki tiznena" vegomer: 
Sota sheyyesh lah zechut talmud tora af al pi sheenah metzuvva al talmud tora hare ze tole lah veenah meta lishatah ella nimmoket veholechet vocholaim kevedim bain aleha ad shettamut achar shana o shetayim o shalosh lefi zechutah. vehi meta bitzviyyat beten uvinfilat evarin: 
Sota sheshshatat me hammarim velo meta miyyad hare hi mutteret levalah. vaafillu haya kohen. veaf al pi shehitchilu hecholaim lavo aleha vechalu shear evareha hoil velo tzavta bitnah velo hitchil yerechah linpol hare zo mutteret. aval mishshehitchil bitnah latzbot virechah linpol hare zo asura vaddait: 
Sota sheshatat vehayta tehora hare zo mitchazzeket ufaneha mazhirot. veim haya bah choli yasur. vetitabber veteled zachar. veim haya darkah leled bekoshi teled bimhera. haya darkah leled nekevot teled zecharim: 
Bau ede tuma achar sheshshatta hare zo tetze belo ketubba vaasura levalah. vaafillu lo era lah davar middevarim ellu mippene sheen hammayim bodkin ella mi sheen lah edim shemmodiin zenutah. veod shemma balah eno menukke meavon lefichach lo badku hammayim et ishto. aval im ba ed echad veheid shehayta temea enah asura veteshev tachat balah shehare shatta: 
Ishsha shezzinneta beones o bishgaga o shebba aleha ze shekkinne lah immo derech evarim en hammayim bodkin otah shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 13)</small> "vehi lo nitpasa" perat laanusa shehare nitpesa bechazka. <small>(Bamidbar 5 27)</small> "vattiml maal beishah" perat leshogeget. <small>(Bamidbar 5 13)</small> "veshachav ish otah shichvat zera" perat leva aleha derech evarim:

Bachamisha asar baadar nifnin bet din letzarche harabbim. uvodkin al haruya lishtot lehashekotah. veal haruya lekanne lah ulehotziah belo ketubba. uvechol zeman mashkin et hassotot: 
Veen mashkin et hassota ella bayyom. vechol hayyom kasher lehashekot sota. veen mashkin shete sotot keachat shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 16)</small> "veheemid otah hakkohen": 
Sota sheamra eni shota mechamat yira vafachad sheyyesh lah yechola lachazor velomar hareni shota. aval amra eni shota vehi beria veenah yerea velo pochedet enah yechola lachazor velomar hinni shota: 
Amra eni shota kodem shettimmachek hammegilla hare megillatah nignezet veenah keshera lehashekot bah sota acheret. uminchatah mitpazzeret al haddeshen. veim amra eni shota achar shennimchaka hammegilla meararin otah umashkin otah beal karchah: 
Umeayyemin aleha shettishte veomrin lah bitti im barur lach haddavar shettehora at imdi al buryech usheti veal tifchadi lefi sheen hammayim domin ella lesam yavesh munnach al basar chay. yesh sham makka mechalchel veyored. en sham makka eno ose kelum: 
Amra temea ani af al pi shennimchaka hammegilla hammayim nishpachin mippene sheen bahen kedushsha. uminchatah mitpazzeret al haddeshen: 
Megillat sota shekketavah ballayla pesula shenneemar vechatav vegomer <small>(Bamidbar 5 24)</small> "vehishka" vegomer <small>(Bamidbar 5 25)</small> "vehikriv" vegomer keshem shekkarbanah bayyom kach ketivat hammegilla vehashekayatah bayyom. ketavah lemafrea pesula shenneemar haala al hasseder. ketavah kodem shettekabbel aleha hashshevua pesula shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 21)</small> "vehishbia" vechatav: 
Ketavah iggeret pesula shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 23)</small> "bassefer". ketavah al shene dappin pesula shenneemar bassefer sefer echad velo shenayim ushelosha. veeno kotev lo al hanneyar velo al haddiftera ella bimgillat sefer shenneemar bassefer. veim ketavah al neyar o diftera pesula: 
Veim ketavah yisrael o kohen katan pesula shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 23)</small> "vechatav hakkohen". eno kotvah lo bekomos velo bekankantom velo bechol davar sherishshumo nikkar veomed ella bidyo sheen bo kankantom shenneemar vechatav <small>(Bamidbar 5 23)</small> "umacha" ketav shehu yachol lehimmachot. veim katav bedavar hammitkayyem pesula: 
Nishar bammegilla roshem ketav nikkar pesula ad sheyyimchok yafe yafe. katav ot achat umechakah vechazar vechatav ot sheniyya umechakah ad shehishlim pesula ad shettihye kullah ketuva: 
Ketavah shello lishmah o mechakah shello lishmah pesula. katav shete megillot lishte sotot umechakan letoch kos echad o letoch shete kosot veervan bechos echad vehishka lishtehen pesula. lefi shekkol achat mehen lo shatta megillatah. mechakan bishne kosot veervan vechazar vechillekan lishne hakkosot lo yashke otan veim hishka kasher. veim nishpechu hammayim hare ze kotev megilla acheret umevi mayim acherim. nishpechu venishtayyer mehen lo yashke et hashshear. veim hishka kasher: 
Me sota shellanu nifsalin belina. hikdim afar lammayim pesula. lo haya sham afar bahechol mevi afar mibbachutz umannicho bahechol velokeach mimmennu venoten al pene hammayim. veeno mevi efer aval mevi rakbuvit shehi keafar: 
Velo yachpor bekordom bahechol veyotzi afar shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 17)</small> "asher yihye bekarka hammishkan". veim chafar vehotzi afar kasher: 
Hikriv et minchatah veachar kach hishkah keshera. nitmet minchatah kodem sheyyannichena bichli sharet hare zo tippade kechol hammenachot shennitmeu kodem sheyyitkaddeshu bichli sharet veyaviu mincha acheret. nitmet hammincha achar shekkiddeshah bichli sharet hare zo tissaref. vechen im amra temea ani kodem shettikkametz hammincha. o sheamra eni shota. o shello ratza balah lehashekotah. o shebbau ede tuma. o shemmet hu. o shemmeta hi. hare hammincha kullah nisrefet. veim era echad meellu achar shekkarav hakkometz en hashsheyarim neechalin: 
Haya balah kohen en sheyare minchatah neechalin mippene sheyyesh labbaal chelek bahem. veenah ola kullah leishshim keminchat zichre kehunna mippene sheyyesh lah chelek bah. ella hakkometz karev leatzmo usheyarim mitpazzerin al bet haddeshen. nimtzeu edeha zommin minchatah tetze lechullin: 
Hamekanne leishto al yede anashim harebe venistera im kol echad veechad mehem hare ze mevi mincha achat al yede kullan keshemmashke otah shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 15)</small> "minchat kenaot hi". mincha achat lekinnuyin harebe: 
Yesh labbaal legalgel bishvua aleha shello zinneta im ish ze shekkinne lah bo velo im ish acher. veshello zinneta tachtav mishshennitarsa kodem shettinnase velo achar shennisset. aval eno megalgel aleha shello zinneta kodem haerusin velo achar sheggershah im gershah vehechezirah. sheim zinneta beet ze lo teaser alav. vechol shettibbael velo tihye asura lo eno matne immah. lefichach im kanas yevimto eno megalgel aleha shello zinneta keshehayta shomeret yavam. aval megalgel aleha shello zinneta tachat achiv sheim zinneta tachat achiv hare zo asura alav. vechen im gershah vehechezirah megalgel aleha shello zinneta tachtav bannissuin harishonim. veyesh lo legalgel aleha bilhabba shello tizne tachtav veshello tizne achar sheyyachzirenna im yegaresh veyachazir. lefichach keshettizne lehabba mayim bodkin otah veyeeru lah otan hameoraot. lechach neemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 22)</small> "amen amen". amen meish ze amen meish acher. amen nesua amen arusa. amen lesheavar amen lehabba: 
Mitzvat chachamim al bene yisrael lekanneot linshehen shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 14)</small> "vekinne et ishto". vechol hamekanne et ishto nichnesa bo ruach tohora. velo yekanne lah lo mittoch sechok velo mittoch sicha velo mittoch kallut rosh velo mittoch meriva velo lehattil aleha ema. veim avar vekinne lah bifne edim mittoch echad mikkol haddevarim haellu hare ze kinnuy: 
En rauy likpotz ulekanneot bifne edim techilla ella beno levenah benachat uvederech tohora veazhara kede lehaderichah bederech yeshara ulehasir hammichshol. vechol mi sheeno makpid al ishto veal banav uvene beto umazhiran ufoked darchehen tamid ad sheyyeda shehen shelemin mikkol chet umeavon hare ze chote shenneemar <small>(Iyov 5 24)</small> "veyadata ki shalom oholecha ufakadta navcha velo techeta":
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 1: Hava al achat mikkol haarayot haamurot battora bemezid chayyav karet shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 18 29)</small> "ki kol asher yaase mikkol hattoevot haelle venichretu hannefashot" vegomer shenehem habboel vehannivelet. veim hayu shoggin chayyavin chattat kevua. veyesh min haarayot shehu bemitat bet din yeter al hakkaret hashshave bechullan:
Otan haarayot sheyyesh bahen mitat bet din im hayu sham edim vehateraa velo parshu mimmaasehem memitin otan mita haamura bahen:
Vaafillu haya haover talmid chacham en memitin velo malkin ad shettihye sham hateraa. shello nittena hateraa bechol makom ella lehavechin ben shogeg lemezid:

Haarayot sheyyesh bahen mitat bet din mehen shemmitatan biskila. umehen shemmitatan bisrefa. umehen shemmitatan bechenek. veellu shemmitatan biskila. habba al immo. veal eshet aviv. veal eshet beno vehi hannikret kallato. vehashshochev im zachar. vehashshochev im behema. vehaishsha hammevia et habbehema aleha:

Veellu hen haarayot shemmitatan bisrefa. habba al bat ishto bechayye ishto. veal bat bittah. veal bat benah. veal em ishto. veal em immah. veal em aviha. vehabba al bitto. veal bat bitto. veal bat beno:

En lecha erva bechenek ella eshet ish bilvad shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 20 10)</small> "mot yumat hannoef vehannoafet" umita haamura battora setam hi chenek. veim hayta bat kohen hi bisrefa uvoalah bechenek shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 9)</small> "uvat ish kohen ki techel liznot" <small>(Vayikra 21 9)</small> "baesh tissaref". veim hayta naara meorasa shenehem biskila shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 24)</small> "ki tihye naara vetula" vegomer <small>(Devarim 22 24)</small> "usekaltem otam baavanim". vechol makom shenneemar battora<small>(Vayikra 20 13)</small> <small>(Vayikra 20 16)</small> "mot yumetu demehem bam" hare hen biskila:
Shear haarayot kullan becharet bilvad veen bahem mitat bet din. lefichach im hayu sham edim vehateraa bet din malkin otan. shekkol chayyave keretot lokin:

Habba al achat mechayyave lavin bemezid. hu loke vehi. veim beshogeg peturin mikkelum. vehabba al achat mehashsheniyyot bemezid makkin oto makkat mardut middivrehem. aval habba al achat mechayyave ase eno loke. veim hikku otam bet din makkat mardut kede leharechik min haavera harshut beyadam:

Anus patur mikkelum min hammalkot umin hakkarban veen tzarich lomar min hammita shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 26)</small> "velannaara lo taase davar". bamme devarim amurim beshenneenas hannival. aval habboel en lo ones sheen kishshuy ella ledaat. veishsha shettechillat biatah beones vesofah beratzon petura mikkelum shemmishshehitchil livol beones en beyadah shello tirtze sheyyetzer haadam vetivo kofe otah lirtzot:

Hammachnis rosh haatara bilvad hu hannikra meare milleshon <small>(Vayikra 20 18)</small> "et mekorah heera". vehammachnis kol haevar hu hannikra gomer. uvechol habbiot haasurot echad hameare veechad haggomer veaf al pi shello hotzi shichvat zera veaf al pi shepperash velo gamar kevan shehichnis rosh haatara nitchayyevu shenehem mitat bet din o karet o malkot o makkat mardut. (veechad habba al haerva kedarkah veechad habba aleha shello kedarkah) mishsheyyeare bah yitchayyevu shenehen mita o karet o malkot o makkat mardut ben shehayu shochvin ben shehayu omdim al hachenasat haatara hu hachiyyuv:

Kol habba bia asura belo kishshuy. ella shehaya haevar shello meduldal kemo evar hammetim kegon hacholim. o mi shennolad kach kegon seris chamma af al pi shehichnis et haevar beyado eno chayyav lo karet velo malikot vien tzarich lomar mita. sheen zo bia. aval posel hu min hattiruma. uvet din makkin et shinehem makkat mariddut:

Habba al erva min haarayot kemitassek af al pi sheen kavvanato lechach chayyav. vechen bechayyave lavin uvishniyyot. aval habba al erva min haarayot vehi meta patur mikkelum. veen tzarich lomar bechayyave lavin shehu patur. vehabba al hatterefa o sheshshachav im behema terefa chayyav. chay hu af al pi shessofo lamut mecholi ze. vaafillu shachat bah shene simanin vaadayin hi mefarkeset habba aleha chayyav ad shettamut o ad sheyyattiz roshah:

Kol ishsha asura meellu im hayta bat shalosh shanim veyom echad vamala gadol habba aleha chayyav mita o karet o malkot vehi petura mikkelum ella im ken hayta gedola. veim hayta pechuta mizze hare shenehen peturin sheen biatah bia. vechen ishsha gedola shebba aleha katan im haya ben tesha shanim veyom echad vamala hi chayyevet karet o mita o malkot vehu patur. veim haya ben tesha shanim ulematta shenehem peturin:

Habba al hazzachar o hevi zachar alav kevan sheheera im hayu shenehem gedolim niskalim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 18 22)</small> "veet zachar lo tishkav" ben shehaya boel o nival. veim haya katan ben tesha shanim veyom echad vamala ze shebba alav o hevio al atzmo niskal vehakkatan patur. veim haya hazzachar ben tesha o pachot shenehen peturin verauy levet din lehakkot haggadol makkat mardut lefi sheshshachav im zachar veaf al pi shehu pachot mibben tesha:

[Echad habba al hazzachar o] habba al anderoginus derech zichruto chayyav. [veim ba alav derech nekevuto patur] vehattumtum safek hu lefichach habba al hattumtum o al anderoginus [derech nekevuto] makkin oto makkat mardut vehaanderoginus muttar lissa ishsha:

Habba al habbehema o shehevi behema alav shenehen niskalin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 18 23)</small> "uvechol behema lo titten shechavtecha" ben sheribbeah o heviah alav. veechad behema veechad chayya vaof hakkol biskila. velo chillak hakkatuv bivhema ben gedola liktanna shenneemar uvechol behema afillu beyom ledatah (habba aleha ben kedarkah ben shello kedarkah) kevan sheheera bah o sheheerta bo chayyav:

Katan ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al habbehema o heviah alav hi niskelet al yado vehu patur. haya ben tesha o pachot en soklin et habbehema. vechen ketanna bat shalosh shanim veyom echad shehevia behema vechayya aleha ben behema gedola ben behema ketanna kevan sheheerta bah habbehema (ben kedarkah ben shello kedarkah) habbehema niskelet vehi petura. veim hayta gedola shenehen niskalin. veim hayta mibbat shalosh shanim ulematta en habbehema niskelet:

Vechen hashshochev im habbehema bishgaga vehaishsha shehevia et habbehema aleha bishgaga en habbehema niskelet al yadan veaf al pi shehen gedolim. kol haarayot kullan shehaya echad gadol veechad katan hakkatan patur vehaggadol chayyav kemo shebbearnu. echad er veechad yashen hayyashen patur. echad mezid veechad shogeg hammezid chayyav vehashshogeg mevi karban. echad anus veechad beratzon haanus patur kemo shebbearnu:

En haedim nizkakin lirot hamenaafim sheheeru ze baze vehichnis kemichchol bishfoferet. ella mishsheyyiru otan devukin ze im ze kederech kol habboalin hare ellu neheragin biriyya zo. veen omrim shemma lo heera, mippene shechezkat tzura zo sheheera:

Mi shehuchzak bisher basar danin bo al pi hachazaka. af al pi sheen sham reaya berura shezze karov. umalkin vesorfin vesoklin vechonkin al chazaka zo. ketzad. hare shehuchzak shezzo achoto o bitto o immo uva aleha beedim hare ze loke o nisraf o niskal veaf al pi sheen sham reaya berura shezzo hi achoto o immo o bitto ella bachazaka bilvad. umaase beishsha achat shebbat lirushalayim vetinok murkav lah al ketefah vehigdilattu bechezkat shehu benah uva aleha veheviuha levet din usekaluha. reaya ledin ze ma sheddana tora bimkallel aviv umakke aviv sheyyumat. uminnayin lanu reaya berura shezze aviv, ella bachazaka, kach shear kerovim bachazaka:

Ish veishsha shebbau mimmedinat hayyam hu omer zot ishti vehi omeret ze bali. im huchzeka bair sheloshim yom shehi ishto horgin aleha. aval betoch hashsheloshim yom en horgin aleha mishshum eshet ish:

Haishsha shehuchzeka nidda bishchunoteha balah loke aleha mishshum nidda. hamekanne leishto venistera uva ed echad veheid shennitmea vehaya balah kohen uva aleha achar kach hare ze loke aleha mishshum zona. af al pi sheikkar haedut beed echad kevar huchzeka bezona:

Haav sheamar bitti zo mekuddeshet hi laze af al pi shehu neeman vetinnase lo im zinneta enah niskelet al piv ad sheyyihyu sham edim shennitarsa bifnehem. vechen haishsha sheamra mekuddeshet ani enah nehereget al piha ad sheyyihyu sham edim o tuchzak:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 2:
Eshet aviv veeshet beno veeshet achiv veeshet achi aviv arbatan erva alav leolam. ben min haerusin ben min hannissuin. ben shennitgarshu ben shello nitgarshu. ben bechayye balehen ben achar mitat balehen. chutz meeshet achiv shello hinniach ben. veim ba al achat mehen bechayye balah chayyav shetayim. mishshum sheer basar umishshum eshet ish. shehare shenehen haissurin bain keechad: 
Lefichach habba al immo shehi eshet aviv chayyav shetayim. ben bechayye aviv ben leachar mitat aviv. achat mishshum immo veachat mishshum eshet aviv. echad achiv meaviv o achiv meimmo. ben minnissuin ben mizzenut. ishto erva alav. aval eshet achi aviv min haem hare hi sheniyya kemo shebbearnu. veechad achoto meaviv o meimmo. ben min hannissuin ben mizzenut. kegon shezzanta immo o aviv im acherim vehayta lo achot mizzenut. hare zo erva alav shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 18 9)</small> "moledet bayit o moledet chutz": 
Bat eshet aviv shehi achoto meaviv hare hi erva alav shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 18 11)</small> "ervat bat eshet avicha moledet avicha". aval im nasa aviv ishsha veyesh lah bat meish acher otah habbat mutteret lo sheen zo moledet aviv. vahalo mishshum achoto chayyav aleha velamma neemar <small>(Vayikra 18 11)</small> "bat eshet avicha" lechayyev aleha af mishshum ze: 
Lefichach habba al achoto shehi bat nesuat aviv chayyav shetayim. achat mishshum <small>(Vayikra 18 9)</small> "ervat achotcha" veachat mishshum <small>(Vayikra 18 11)</small> "ervat bat eshet avicha". aval im anas aviv ishsha o pitta otah veholid mimmenna bat uva aleha eno chayyav ella mishshum achoto bilvad. sheen bat haanusa bat eshet aviv: 
Achot immo ben achotah meaviha ben achotah meimmah ben min hannissuin ben mizzenut hare zo erva alav mishshum achot em. vechen achot haav ben min haem ben min haav ben min hannissuin ben mizzenut hare zo erva alav mishshum achot av: 
Habba al ishsha derech zenut veholid mimmenna bat otah habbat erva alav mishshum bitto. veaf al pi shello neemar battora ervat bittecha lo tegalle meachar sheasar bat habbat shatak min habbat veissurah min hattora. veeno middivre sofrim. lefichach habba al bitto minnesuato chayyav shetayim. mishshum bitto umishshum ervat ishsha uvittah: 
Kevan shekkiddesh adam ishsha neesru alav mikkerovoteha shesh nashim. vechol achat mehen erva alav leolam ben kanas ben geresh ben bechayye ishto ben leachar motah. veellu hen. immah veem immah veem aviha uvittah uvat bittah uvat benah. veim ba al achat mehen bechayye ishto shenehen nisrafin: 
Ba alehen leachar mitat ishto hare ellu becharet veen bahen mitat bet din. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 20 14)</small> "baesh yisrefu oto veethen". bizman sheshshetehen kayyamot shehen ishto vezo shebba aleha hare hu vehaerva nisrafin. uvizman sheen shetehen kayyamot en sham serefa: 
Vechen achot ishto erva alav ad shettamut ishto. ben achotah meimmah ben achotah meaviha ben min hannissuin ben mizzenut hare zo erva alav: 
Avar venaaf im achat mishsheva nashim ellu ben bezadon ben bishgaga af al pi shehu vehannoefet bemitat bet din o becharet lo neesra ishto alav chutz meachot arusato shehi oseret ishto alav kemo shebbearnu behilchot gerushin: 
Habboel ishsha derech zenut lo neesru alav kerovoteha shehen hashsheva nashim sheamarnu. aval chachamim asru al mi shennaaf im ishsha lissa achat min hashsheva nashim kerovoteha kol zeman shehazzona kayyemet. mippene shehazzona baa likrovoteha levakker otan vehu mityached immah velibbo gas bah veyavo lide avera sheyyivol haerva. velo od ella afillu nitan al ishsha hare ze lo yissa achat mikkerovoteha ad shettamut zo shennitan aleha. veim kanas hakkerova shezzana im kerovoteha lo yotzi: 
Mi shennitan al erva o sheyyatza lo shem ra immah lo yadur immah bemavoy echad velo yerae beotah shechuna. umaase shehayu merannenin acharav im chamoto vehikku oto chachamim makkat mardut mippene sheavar al petach betah: 
Habba al ishsha uvittah derech zenut o al ishsha vaachotah vechayyotze bahen hare ze kemi shebba al shete nashim nachriyyot sheen naasot erva zo im zo ella benissuin lo biznut. vechen im anas aviv o beno o achiv o achi aviv ishsha o pitta otah hare zo mutteret lo veyissaenna shello neemar ella eshet veen kan ishut: 
Aviv o beno shennasa ishsha hare ze muttar lissa bittah o immah kemo shebbearnu. umuttar leadam lissa eshet ben achiv. venose adam ishsha uvat achotah o bat achiha keachat. umitzvat chachamim sheyyissa adam bat achoto vehu haddin levat achiv shenneemar <small>(yeshaya noach 7)</small> "umibbesarcha lo titallam":
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 3: Hava al eshet katan afillu hayta yevama shebba aleha ben tesha shanim veyom echad hare ze patur. vechen habba al eshet cheresh veshote veeshet tumtum veanderoginus veal hachereshet veal hashshota eshet happikkeach veal ishsha shehi mekuddeshet besafek o megoreshet besafek kullan peturin. veim hayu mezidin makkin otan makkat mardut:

Habba al hakketanna eshet haggadol im kiddeshah aviha hare ze bechenek vehi petura mikkelum veneesra al balah kemo shebbearnu behilchot sota. veim hi bat meun makkin oto makkat mardut vehi mutteret levalah. vaafillu haya kohen:

Bat kohen shezzinneta keshehi eshet ish. ben shehaya balah kohen ben shehaya yisrael vaafillu haya balah mamzer o natin o shear mechayyave lavin hare zo bisrefa shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 9)</small> "uvat kohen ki techel liznot". uvoalah bechenek. vechen bat yisrael eshet kohen bechenek kedin kol eshet ish:

Habba al naara meorasa shenehen biskila. veenan chayyavin sekila ad shettihye naara betula meorasa vehi bevet aviha. hayta bogeret o shennichnesa lechuppa af al pi shello nivala afillu mesarah haav lishluche habbaal vezinneta badderech hare zo bechenek:
Vehabba al ketanna meorasa bevet aviha hu biskila vehi petura. venaara meorasa bat kohen shezzinneta biskila:

Bau aleha asara vehi betula birshut aviha ze achar ze hare harishon biskila vechullan bechenek (bamme devarim amurim shebbau aleha kedarkah aval im bau aleha shello kedarkah adayin hi betula vechullan biskila):
Naara meorasa shehayta meshuchreret o giyyoret af al pi shennishtachrera venitgayyera vehi pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim veyom echad hare zo bechenek kechol eshet ish:

Din chadash yesh bemotzi shem ra. uma hu hachiddush. sheim nimtza haddavar emet uvau edim shezzinneta keshehayta naara meorasa af al pi shezzinneta achar sheyyatza mibbet aviha vaafillu shezzinneta achar shennichnesa lachuppa kodem beilat habbaal soklin otah al petach bet aviha. aval shear nearot meorasot shello haya lahen din hotzaat shem ra shezzanu meachar sheyyatzu mibbet haav hare hen bechenek kemo shebbearnu. ha lamadta shebbeeshet ish shalosh mitot. yesh eshet ish shehi bechenek. veyesh eshet ish shehi bisrefa. veyesh eshet ish shehi biskila:

Vehechan soklin naara meorasa shezzinneta. im zinneta bevet aviha af al pi shello heidu aleha haedim ella achar shebbaa levet chamiha (veniset) hare zo niskelet al petach bet aviha. zinnita bivet chamiha kodem sheyyimisor otah haav af al pi sheheidu aleha achar shechazra levet aviha hare zo niskelet al petach shaar hair hahi:
Bau edim achar shebbagra o achar shebbealah balah af al pi sheheidu shezzinneta bevet aviha keshehayta naara hare zo niskelet bevet hassekila:

Hayta horatah shello bikdushsha veledatah bikdushsha niskelet al petach shaar hair. kol mi shemmitzvatah liskol otah al petach shaar hair im hayta ir sherubbah akkum soklin otah al petach bet din. vechol mi shemmitzvatah liskol otah al petach bet aviha im lo haya lah av o shehaya lah av velo haya lo bayit hare zo niskelet bevet hassekila. lo neemar <small>(Devarim 22 21)</small> "petach bet av" ella lemitzva:

Habba al erva min haarayot biot harebe chayyav karet o mitat bet din al kol bia uvia af al pi sheen bet din yecholin lehamit ella mita achat hare habbiot nechshavot lo kaaverot harebe. vechen im ba bia achat shechayyavin aleha mishshemot harebe im haya shogeg mevi karban al kol shem veshem. af al pi shehi bia achat kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot shegagot. veim haya mezid hare zo nechshevet lo kaaverot harebe. vechen yesh ba bia achat veloke aleha malkiyyot harebe kemo sheyyitbaer:

Shifcha charufa haamura battora hi shechetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin umekuddeshet leeved ivri shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 20)</small> "lo yumetu ki lo chuppasha". ha im nishtachrera kullah chayyavin aleha mitat bet din shehare naaset eshet ish gemura kemo shebbearnu behilchot ishut:

Biat shifcha zo meshunna mikkol biot asurot shebbattora. shehare hi loka shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 20)</small> "bikkoret tihye" vehu chayyav karban asham shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 21)</small> "vehevi et ashamo". echad shogeg echad mezid beshifcha charufa mevi asham. vehabba aleha biot harebe ben bezadon ben bishgaga mevi asham echad. aval hi chayyevet malkot al kol bia uvia im hayta mezida kishar chayyave lavin:

Hameare beshifcha charufa velo gamar biato patur ad sheyyigmor biato. veeno chayyav ella al haggedola habbeula hammezida uvirtzonah. aval im hayta ketanna o shello hayta beula o hayta shogeget o anusa o yeshena patur [vechen im ba aleha shello kedarkah patur shebbeshifcha charufa lo hishva bia kedarkah levia shello kedarkah shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 20)</small> "shichvat zera". aval bishar biot lo chalak ben bia levia shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 18 22)</small> <small>(Vayikra 20 13)</small> "mishkeve ishsha" maggid [lecha] hakkatuv sheshshene mishkavot beishsha]:
Kol makom sheamarnu beshifcha shehu patur hu patur min hakkarban vehi petura min hammalkot. aval makkin oto makkat mardut middivrehem im hayu shenehen mezidin ugedolim:

Ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al shifcha charufa hi loka vehu mevi karban. vehu shettihye gedola uveula uvirtzonah kemo shebbearnu. sheen haish chayyav karban ad shettitchayyev hi malkot shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 20)</small> "bikkoret tihye" <small>(Vayikra 19 21)</small> "vehevi et ashamo":
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 4: Hannida hare hi kishar kol haarayot. hameare bah [ben kedarkah ben shello kedarkah] chayyav karet vaafillu hayta ketanna bat shalosh shanim veyom echad kishar arayot shehabbat mittammea benidda vaafillu beyom ledatah. uvat asara yamim metammea beziva vedavar ze mippi hashshemua lamdu sheen hefresh ben gedola liktanna letumat niddot vezavot:

Veechad habba al hannidda kol shivat hayyamim vaafillu lo raata ella yom rishon. veechad habba al yoledet zachar kol shiva o al yoledet nekeva kol arbaa asar. o al hazzava kol yeme zovah usefiratah. ben shifcha ben meshuchreret hakkol becharet shenneemar benidda <small>(Vayikra 15 19)</small> "shivat yamim tihye beniddatah". uvezava neemar <small>(Vayikra 15 25)</small> "kol yeme zov tumatah kime niddatah tihye". uveyoledet zachar hu omer <small>(Vayikra 12 2)</small> "kime niddat devotah titma". uveyoledet nekeva <small>(Vayikra 12 5)</small> "vetama shevuayim keniddatah":

Bamme devarim amurim shehattuma teluya beyamim beshettavla beme mikve achar hayyamim hassefurim. aval nidda vezava veyoledet shello tavlu beme mikve habba al achat mehen afillu achar kamma shanim chayyav karet. shebbeyamim utevila tala hakkatuv shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 18)</small> "verachatzu vammayim" ze binyan av lechol tame shehu betumato ad sheyyitbol:

Haakkum en chayyavin alehem mishshum nidda velo mishshum zava velo mishshum yoledet. vachachamim gazru al kol haakkum hazzecharim vehannekevot sheyyehu kezavim tamid ben rau ben lo rau leinyan tuma vetohora:

Kol dam shettire hayyoledet betoch 33 shel zachar vesv shel nekeva hu hannikra dam tohar. veen monea et haishsha mibbalah ella tovelet achar shiva lezachar veachar arbaa asar linikeva umishammeshet mittatah af al pi shehaddam shotet veyored:

Kol chayyave tevilot tevilatan bayyom chutz minnidda veyoledet shehare hu omer benidda <small>(Vayikra 15 19)</small> "shivat yamim tihye beniddatah". hashshiva kullan beniddatah vetovelet belel shemini. vechen yoledet zachar belel shemini veyoledet nekeva belel chamishsha asar. shehayyoledet kenidda kemo shebbearnu:
Nitachara yamim rabbim velo tavla keshettitbol lo titbol ella ballayla sheim titbol bayyom yitu vetavo nidda acheret litbol bishvii:

Hayta chola o shehaya mekom hattevila rachok veen hannashim yecholot lehaggia lo velachazor ballayla mippene hallistim o mippene hatztzinna o mippene shennoalin shaare hammedina ballayla hare zo tovelet bayyom hashshemini o bayyamim shel acharav bayyom:

Kol hannashim sheyyesh lahen veset bechezkat tohora levalehen ad shettomar lo temea ani o ad shettuchzak nidda bishchenoteha. halach balah limdina acheret vehenichah tehora kesheyyavo eno tzarich lishol lah afillu metzaah yeshena hare ze muttar lavo aleha shello beonat vistah veeno choshesh shemma nidda hi. veim henichah nidda asura lo ad shettomar lo tehora ani:

Haishsha sheamra levalah temea ani vechazra veamra tehora ani vederech sechok amarti lecha techilla enah neemenet. veim natna amatla lidvareha neemenet. ketzad. tevaah balah vaachoto o immo immah bechatzer veamra temea ani veachar kach chazra veamra tehora ani velo amarti lecha temea ella mippene achotcha veimmecha shemma yiru otanu hare zo neemenet. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Haya meshammesh im hattehora veamra lo nitmeti lo yifrosh miyyad vehu bekishshuyo shehanaa lo bitziato keviato. veim peresh vehu bekishshuyo chayyav karet kemo shebbaal nidda. vehu haddin bishar arayot. ella ketzad yaase. noetz tzipparne raglav bakkarka veshohe veeno mizdaazea ad sheyyamut haevar veachar kach nishmat mimmenna:

Veasur lo laadam lavo al ishto samuch levistah shemma tire dam bishat tashmish shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 lo)</small> "vehizzartem et bene yisrael mittumatam". vechamma. im haya darkah lirot bayyom asur leshammesh mittechillat hayyom. veim haya darkah lirot ballayla asur leshammesh mittechillat hallayla:

Avar vistah velo raata mutteret leshammesh achar shettaavor onat havveset. ketzad. haya darkah lirot beshesh shaot bayyom asura leshammesh mittechillat hayyom. avru shesh shaot bayyom velo raata asura leshammesh ad laerev. vechen im haya darkah lirot beshesh shaot ballayla veavru velo raata asura leshammesh ad shettizrach hashshemesh:

Derech bene yisrael uvenot yisrael leolam livdok atzmam achar hattashmish. ketzad. mekanneach haish atzmo bematlit nechona lo umekannachat haishsha atzmah bematlit nechona lah veroin bahen shemma raata dam bishat tashmish. veyesh laish lehaniach ishto shettivdok bematlit shello mittoch shenneemenet al shellah neemenet al shello:

Begadim ellu shemmekannechin bahen tzerichin sheyyihyu shel pishtan shachakim ulevanim vehem hannikraim edim beinyan ze. vehabbeged shemmekanneach bo hu nikra ed shello. vehabbeged shemmekannachat hi bo nikra ed shellah:

Hatztzenuot en meshammeshot ella ad sheyyivdeku atzman techilla kodem tashmish. veishsha sheen lah veset asura leshammesh ad shettivdok. lefichach hi meshammeshet bishne edim echad lifne hattashmish veechad leachar hattashmish. aval ishsha sheyyesh lah veset enah tzericha ed lifne tashmish ella mishshum tzeniut bilvad. aval achar tashmish hakkol tzerichin shene edim echad lo veechad lah afillu meubberet umenika uzekena. uketanna lo teshammesh ella bishne edim echad lo veechad lah. aval betula veyoshevet al dam tohar enah tzericha edim shehare haddam shotet mimmenna:

Hameshammesh mittato peamim rabbot enan tzerichin livdok shene haedim shellahen al kol bia uvia. ella mekanneach hu beed shello vehi beed shellah achar kol bia uvia shel kol hallayla ulemachar yivdeku haedim. nimtza haddam al ed shellah o al ed shello hare zo temea. shimmesha mittatah vekinnecha atzmah veavad haed hare zo lo teshammesh paam sheniyya ad shettivdok beed acher techilla. shemma dam haya al haed sheavad:
Hinnicha haed tachat hakkar o tachat hakkeset venimtza alav dam. im mashuch temea shechezkato min hakkinnuach. veim haya agol tehora sheen ze ella dam maacholet shenneherga tachat hakkar:

Kinnecha atzmah beed habbaduk lah vetachato birechah ulemachar nimtza alav dam hare zo temea. veen omrim shemma keshettacha otah birechah neherga maacholet. kinnecha atzmah beed sheeno baduk lah velo yada im haya alav dam kodem shettekanneach bo o lo haya. nimtza alav dam im haya haddam kigris veod hare zo nidda. haya pachot mikken tehora sheeno ella min hamaacholet:

Mi sheraata dam bishat tashmish hare zo mutteret leshammesh keshettithar paam sheniyya. raata dam befaam sheniyya meshammeshet paam shelishit. raata dam bashshelishit hare zo asura leshammesh im baal ze leolam. bamme devarim amurim beshello haya sham davar litlot bo. aval im shimmesha samuch levistah tola bavveset. hayta bah makka tola bammakka. veim haya dam makkatah meshunne middam shettire beet hattashmish enah tola bammakka. veneemenet ishsha lomar makka yesh li betoch hammakor shemmimmenna haddam yotze vetihye mutteret levalah. veaf al pi sheddam yotze min hammakor bishat tashmish:

Mi sheraata dam bishat tashmish paam rishona usheniyya ushelishit veen sham davar litlot bo hare zo titgaresh umutteret lehinnase lesheni. nisset lesheni veraata dam kach bishat tashmish shalosh peamim hare zo titgaresh vetinnase lishlishi. nisset lishlishi veraata dam kach bishat tashmish shalosh peamim hare zo titgaresh vaasura lehinnase ad shettavri mecholi ze:

Ketzad bodeket atzmah leda im nirpet o lo nirpet. mevia shefoferet shel avar ufiha ratzuf letochah umachneset hashshefoferet ad makom shehi yechola. umachneset betoch hashshefoferet michchol umoch munnach al rosho vedofeket oto ad sheyyaggia hammoch letzavvar harechem umotzia hammoch. im nimtza dam al rosh hammoch beyadua shehaddam shehi roa bishat tashmish min hammakor. veim lo nimtza al hammoch kelum beyadua shehaddam sheroa middochak hatztzedadin utehora hi umutteret lehinnase laacherim kemo shebbearnu behilchot ishut:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 5: Haisha mittammet beones ben lenidda ben lezivut. ketzad. kegon shekkaftza mimmakom lemakom. o raata behema o chayya o of mitassekin ze im ze vechamda veraata dam. vechen kol kayyotze baze hoil veraata dam mikkol makom nitmet umetammea bechol shehu. afillu raata dam tippa kechardal hare zo kemi shezzav mimmenna damim harebe:

Kol hannashim mittammeot babbayit hachitzon. veaf al pi shello yatza haddam lachutz ella neekar min harechem velo shatat hoil veyatza mibben hashshinnayim hare zo temea veaf al pi sheadayin haddam bivsarah shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 19)</small> "dam yihye zovah bivsarah". vead hechan hu ben hashshinnayim ad makom sheyyaggia elav haevar bishat gemar bia. uven hashshinnayim atzmo kilfanim:

Mashal mashlu chachamim baishsha. harechem shennotzar bo havvalad hu hannikra makor. vehu sheddam nidda vezava yotze mimmennu. vekorin oto cheder lefi shehu lifnay velifnim. vetzavvar harechem kullo vehu hammakom haaroch shemmitkkabbetz rosho bishat haibbur kede shello yippol havvalad veniftach harebe bishat leda korin oto perozdor kelomar shehu bet shaar larechem:

Uvishat gemar bia haevar nichnas bifrozdor veeno maggia ad rosho shemmibbifnim ella rachok mimmennu meat lefi haetzbaot. ulemala min hacheder umin happerozdor ben cheder lifrozdor hu hammakom sheyyesh bo shete betzim shel ishsha. vehashshevilim shebbahen mitbashshelet shichvat zera shellah makom ze hu hannikra aliyya. uchemo nekev patuach min haaliyya legag happerozdor venekev ze korin oto lul. vehaevar nichnas lifnim min hallul bishat gemar bia:

Dam habba min hacheder kullo tame chutz middam tohar shehattora tiharattu vedam koshi kemo sheyyitbaer. vedam haaliyya kullo tahor shehu kemo dam makka shebbammeayim o bakkaved o bechuleya vechayyotze bahen. vedam hannimtza bapperozdor im nimtza min hallul ulefanim hare ze tame shechezkato min hacheder. vechayyavin alav al biat mikdash vesorfin alav teruma vekadashim veen omrim shemma min haaliyya yarad derech hannekev. sherov haddamim hannimtzain kan min hacheder. nimtza haddam bapperozdor chutz lannekev hare tumato besafek shemma min hacheder ba o min haaliyya shatat derech hallul. lefichach en sorfin alav teruma vekadashim veen chayyavin alav al biat hammikdash:

Lo kol mashke habba min hacheder metamme ella haddam bilvad shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 19)</small> "dam yihye zovah". lefichach im shatat min harechem loven o mashke yarok af al pi shessemichato kedam hoil veen marav mare dam hare ze tahor:
Vachamishsha damim temeim baishsha vehashshear tehorin. veellu hen. haadom. vehashshachor. uchekeren karkom. uchememe adama. ucheyayin hammazug:

Haadom ketzad hu eno. keammud sheyyatza rishon middam hakkaza shel bene adam, noten haddam bechos umakkif lo veroehu. vehashshachor keen haddeyo hayyavesh. kekeren karkom ketzad. yavi karkom lach begush adama shealav velokeach min habbarur shebbo hakkane haemtzai shello shekkullo kemo kane hu uvechol echad veechad shelosha kanim uvechol kane shelosha alim umakkif haddam leale haemtzai shebbakkane haemtzai veroe bo. kememe adama ketzad. yavi adama mibbikat sichne vechayyotze bah shehi adumma venoten aleha mayim bichli ad sheyyaale hammayim al heafar kiklippat hashshum. veen shiur lammayim velo leafar. umeakkeran bichli umeshaer bahen lishato uvimkomo keshehen achurin. veim tzallu chozer umeakkeran:

Arbaa marot hallalu im haya mare haddam kemare kol echad mehen o amok mehen hare ze tame. haya diha mimmennu hare ze tahor. ketzad. haya haddam shachor yeter mikkidyo hayyavesh temea. haya pachot mimmennu kegon shehaya marehu keen hazzayit hashshachor o keen hazzefet o keen haorev hare ze tahor. vechen bishar hashshelosha marot:

Keyayin hammazug ketzad. chelek echad yayin min hayyayin hashsharoni shel eretz yisrael chay vechadash ushene chalakim mayim. haya mare haddam amok mimmennu o diha mimmennu hare ze tahor ad sheyyihye kemezeg ze bilvad. veneemenet ishsha lomar kemare ze raiti veibbadtiv vehechacham metamme lah o metaher:

Ketzad makkif veroe. lokeach hammatlit sheyyesh bah haddam beyado umabbit bo uvaddeyo. o beale shel karkom. o bedam hakkaza shebbakkos. o bememe adama. o bemezeg shebbakkos. veorech lah kefi ma sheenav root umetamme o metaher. veeno mabbit bazzechuchit shel kos mibbachutz ella bammashke shebbakkos. veyihye hakkos rachav mishkalo mane umachazik shene login kede shettikkanes bo haora velo yihye afel:

En bodkin haddam ella al gabbe matlit levana uvachamma. veose tzel beyado al haddam vehu omed bachamma kede sheyyire eno kemot shehi. velo kol haroe tzarich lechol ellu haddevarim bechol et sheyyire ella teviut ayin yesh lechacham bedamim. uveet sheyyire miyyad yetamme o yetaher. veim nistappek lo bemare min hammarot tzarich lehakkif velaaroch lidyo o ledam hakkaza o lishar hammarot:
Hammappelet chaticha af al pi shehi adumma im yesh immah dam temea veim lav tehora vaafillu nikrea hachaticha venimtzet melea dam hare zo tehora sheen ze dam nidda ella dam chaticha:

Hippila chaticha kerua vedam agur betochah temea. hippila kemin kelippa kemin saara kemin afar kemo yavchushin im haya mare devarim ellu adom tattil lemayim poshrin. im nimmochu hare zo temea sheddam hu vekafa vechol haroa dam yavesh temea. veim shahu befoshrin meet leet veachar kach nimmochu hare zo safek temea. lo nimmochu meet leet hare ellu mimmakka utehora hi:
Hippila kemin chagavim kemin dagim shekatzim uremasim im yesh immahen dam temea veim lav tehora:

Haishsha shehichnisa shefoferet bapperozdor veraata haddam betoch hashshefoferet tehora shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 19)</small> "dam yihye zovah bivsarah" ad shettire bivsarah kederech shehannashim root. veen derech haishsha lirot bishfoferet:

Haishsha shehishtina mayim veyatza dam im me raglayim. ben shehishtina vehi omedet ben shehishtina vehi yoshevet hare zo tehora. vaafillu hirgish gufah venizdazea enah chosheshet sheharegashat me raglayim hi zo sheen me raglayim min hacheder vedam ze dam makka hu bachalcholet o bakkuleya:

Dam betulim tahor hu veeno lo dam nidda velo dam ziva sheeno min hammakor ella kemo dam chabbura. vechetzad din habbetula bedamim. im nisset ketanna ben lo raata dam miyyameha ben sheraata dam bevet aviha hare zo mutteret levalah ad shettichye hammakka shekkol dam shettire mechamat hammakka hu. veim raata dam achar shettichye hammakka hare zo nidda:

Nisset keshehi naara im lo raata miyyameha dam hare zo mutteret levalah arbaa yamim bayyom uvallayla af al pi shehaddam shotet vehu shello chayta hammakka. veim raata dam bevet aviha veachar kach nisset en lo lavo aleha ella beila rishona uforesh veyihye dam betulim ze keillu hi techillat nidda. uvogeret shello raata miyyameha notnin lah kol layla harishon:
Arbaa lelot shennotnin lenaara shello raata dam af al pi shehen beserugin boel layla harishon umamtin afillu shene chodashim o shelosha uvoel layla sheni. vehu shello chayta hammakka:
Vechen ketanna shennotnin lah ad shettichye hammakka afillu lo chayta shana hare ze boel kol hashshana ben beserugin ben beyom achar yom:

Ketanna shennisset venaaset naara tachat balah vaadayin haddam shotet mechamat hammakka kol beilot shebbaal keshehi ketanna nechshavot lo kelayla echad umashlimin lo kol arbaa yamim bime hannaarut. vaafillu hayu hashshelosha yamim shennotnin lo bime hannaarut beserugin uvaal bechol shene chodashim layla echad hare ze muttar vehu shello chayta hammakka:

Ketzad yodin im chayta hammakka o lo chayta. hayta roa haddam beet shettaamod ucheshetteshev lo tire uveet shetteshev al hakkarka tire veim teshev al gabbe karim uchesatot lo tire adayin lo chayta hammakka. pasak haddam velo raata kelal ben omedet ben yoshevet al hakkar kevar chayta hammakka. vechen im lo pasak kelal ella tire haddam vaafillu keshehi yoshevet al hakkarim vehakkesatot en ze dam makka ella dam nidda:
Hayta roa beet tashmish hare ze mechamat hammakka. shimmesha mittatah velo raata dam veachar kach raata dam shello mechamat tashmish hare ze dam nidda:

Habboel betula velo yatza mimmenna dam vechazar uvealah veyatza dam afillu hayta ketanna hare ze dam nidda sheillu haya dam betulim haya ba battechilla. habboel pechuta mibbat shalosh veyatza dam hare ze dam betulim:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 6: Dam hannidda vedam hazzava vedam hakkoshi vedam yoledet vedam tohar shel yoledet kullo dam echad hu umin hammakor hu ba. umaayan echad hu. uvizmannim bilvad hu sheyyishtanne dino vetihye roa dam zo tehora. vezo nidda. vezo zava:

Ketzad. keshettire haishsha dam techilla o keshettire bishat vestah vehu haet shekkava leniddatah hare zo nidda kol shivat hayyamim. ben raata kol shiva ben shello raata ella tippa rishona bilvad. raata dam bayyom hashshemini hare ze dam ziva mippene shehu belo et niddatah:
Vechen kol dam shettire betoch hayyamim shebben veset nidda leveset nidda hare hu dam ziva. vahalacha lemoshe missinay sheen ben zeman nidda lizman nidda ella achad asar yom bilvad:

Kol shivat hayyamim shennikbea lah veset bitchillatan hen hannikrain yeme niddatah. ben raata bahen dam ben lo raata bahen dam. umippene ma nikrain yeme nidda mippene shehen reuyin lenidda. vechol dam shettire bahem dam nidda yechashev:

Vechol achad asar yom sheachar hashshiva hen hannikrain yeme zivatah. ben raata bahen dam ben lo raata. velamma nikrain yeme ziva mippene shehen reuyin leziva. vechol dam shettire bahen dam ziva yechashev. vehizzaher bishne shemot ellu shehen yeme niddatah vime zivatah:
