Havvalad shehaya mushlach badderech uva echad veamar beni hu vaani hishlachtiv neeman. vechen immo neemenet. neesaf min hashshuk uvau aviv veimmo achar ken veamru benenu hu en neemanin hoil veyatza alav shem asufi. uvishne reavon neemanin shemmippene raav hishlichuhu vehen rotzin sheyyazunu oto acherim ulefichach shatku ad shenneesaf: 
Nimtza havvalad mahul o shehuchtal o shehumlach o shehaya hakkochal beenav o hakkemein betzavvaro o shennimtza tachat ilan mesubbach sheen chayya nichneset lo vehaya samuch lair o shennimtza bevet hakkeneset hassamuch lirshut harabbim o betzidde reshut harabbim en kan mishshum asufi. meacher shehen meshammerin oto shello yamut bechezkat kasher hu. aval im nimtza mushlach beemtza hadderech o rachok min hair afillu tachat ilan o bevet hakkeneset o shennimtza taluy bailan makom shechayya maggaat lo hare ze asufi: 
Neemenet chayya lomar ze habben kohen hu o levi o natin o mamzer mippene shello huchzak veen anu yodin yichusan. bamme devarim amurim beshehuchzeka beneemanut velo irer aleha adam. aval im irer aleha afillu echad veamar besheker meida enah neemenet vahare habben bechezkat kasher veen lo yichus: 
Davar barur shehashshetuki asur lissa shetukit. vaasufi asur baasufit mippene shehen sefekot. aval mamzerim vaddaim unetinim muttarim lavo ze baze vehavvalad mamzer. ushetuki vaasufi muttarin bintinim uvishar haggerim vehavvalad safek:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 16:
Petzua dakka ucherut shafcha shennasu bat yisirael uvaalu lokin shenneemar <small>(Devarim 23 2)</small> "lo yavo fetzua dakka ucherut shafcha bikhal Adonai". umuttarin lissa giyyoret umeshuchreret. vaafillu kohen shehu petzua dakka muttar lissa giyyoret umeshuchreret lefi sheeno bikdushshato. vaafillu netina o echad min hassefekot mutteret lo: 
Hoil ufetzua dakka asur lavo bakkahal lo gazru bo al hannetinim velo al hassefekot. aval petzua dakka ucherut shafcha asur bemamzeret vaddait shehare asura min hattora: 
Ve zehu petzua dakka. kol shenniftzeu habbetzim shello. ucherut shafcha kol shennichrat haggid shello. uvishlosha evarin efshar sheyyippasel hazzachar baggid uvabbetzim uvashshevilin shebbahen titbashshel shichvat zera vehen hannikrain chute betzim. vechevan shenniftza echad mishshelosha evarin ellu o niddach hare ze pasul: 
Ketzad. niftza haggid o niddach o shennichrat haatara o lemala meatara pasul. veim nichrat merosh haatara venishtayyer mimmenna afillu kechut hassaara mukkaf lechol haggid kasher. nichrat haggid lemala meatara kekulmos o kemarzev kasher: 
Nikkav lematta meatara kasher. nikkeva haatara atzmah im kesheyyire keri tetze shichvat zera min hannekev pasul. nistam hannekev chazar lehechshero. nikkav lematta meatara shekkenegdo lemala betoch haatara pasul shehaatara kullah meakkevet: 
Nistam shevil shichvat zera vechazar lirot shichvat zera mishshevil shemmashtin bo hare ze pasul: 
Nichretu habbetzim o achat mehen o shenniftzea achat mehen o shenniddocha achat mehen o shechasra o shennikkeva hare ze pasul. nichretu chute betzim o achat o shenniddach o niftza hare ze pasul: 
Nikkav chut michute habbetzim lishvil me raglayim vahare hu mattil mayim mishshene mekomot mishshevil hammayim umishshevil shichvat zera hare ze kasher: 
Kol pasul sheamarnu beinyan ze keshello hayu bide shamayim kegon shekkerato adam o kelev o hikkahu kotz vechayyotze bidvarim ellu. aval im nolad kerut shafcha o petzua dakka o shennolad belo betzim o shechala mechamat gufo uvatlu mimmennu evarim ellu o shennolad bahem shechin vehemessa otan o keratan hare ze kasher lavo bakkahal shekkol ellu bide shamayim: 
Asur lehafesid evre zera ben beadam ben bivhema chayya veof. echad temeim veechad tehorim. ben beeretz yisrael ben bechutza laaretz. af al pi shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 24)</small> "uveartzechem lo taasu" mippi hashshemua lamdu sheddavar ze noheg bechol makom. veinyan hakkatuv lo yease zot beyisrael ben begufan ben beguf acherim. vechol hamesares loke min hattora bechol makom. vaafillu mesares achar mesares loke: 
Ketzad. hare shebba echad vecharat et haggid uva acher vecharat et habbetzim o nittekan uva acher vecharat chute betzim. o shebba echad umaach et haggid uva acher venitteko uva acher ucherato kullan lokin. veaf al pi shello seres haacharon ella mesoras. ben baadam ben bivhema chayya vaof. vehamesares et hannekeva ben beadam ben bishar minim patur: 
Hammashke ikkarin leadam o lishar minim kede lesarso hare ze asur veen lokin alav. veishsha mutteret lishtot ikkarin kede lesarsah ad shello teled. hare shekkafa et haadam veshissa bo kelev o shear chayyot ad sheasauhu kerut shafcha o shehoshivo bammayim o bashsheleg ad shebbittel mimmennu evre tashmish eno loke ad sheyyesares beyado. verauy lehakkoto makkat mardut: 
Asur lomar leakkum lesares behema shellanu. veim lekachah hu meatzmo vesersah muttar. veim heerim yisrael bedavar ze konsin oto umochrah leyisrael acher. vaafillu livno haggadol muttar lemachrah. aval livno hakkatan eno mochrah lo velo notna lo:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 17:
Shalosh nashim neesru al kol hakkohanim. gerusha zona vachlola. vial kohen gadol arba. ellu hashshalosh vehaalmana. echad kohen gadol mashuach beshemen hammishcha o hamerubbe begadim. veechad kohen haoved veechad kohen gadol shemminnuhu veavar. vechen kohen meshuach milchama. kullan metzuvvin al habbetula vaasurin bealmana: 
Kol kohen shennasa achat mehashshalosh nashim ellu ben gadol ben hedyot uvaal loke. veim ba aleha derech zenut eno loke mishshum zona o gerusha o chalala shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 7)</small> "lo yikkachu" ad sheyyikkach veyivol: 
Aval kohen gadol shebba al almana loke achat af al pi shello kiddesh shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 15)</small> "lo yechallel" kevan shebbealah chillelah ufesalah lichhunna. aval zona vachalala ugerusha hare hen mechullalot veomdot kodem beilato. ulefichach loke kohen gadol levaddo al beilat almana levaddah af al pi sheen sham kiddushin shehare chillelah vehu muzhar shello yechallel kesherim lo ishsha velo zaro: 
Kiddesh kohen gadol almana uvealah loke shetayim. achat mishshum <small>(Vayikra 21 14)</small> "almana lo yikkach". veachat mishshum <small>(Vayikra 21 15)</small> "lo yechallel". uven kohen gadol uven kohen hedyot shennasa ishsha min haarba velo baal eno loke: 
Vechol makom shehu loke hi loka. vechol makom shehu eno loke hi enah loka. sheen hefresh ben ish leishsha loonashin zulati beshifcha charufa bilvad kemo shebbearnu: 
Kol kohen habba al hakkutit ben gadol ben hedyot loke mishshum zona. shehare enah bat kiddushin vehu asur bivilat zona ben yisreelit ben kutit: 
Hachalutza asura lechohen middivre sofrim mippene shehi kigrusha umakkin oto makkat mardut middivrehem. kohen shennasa sefek chalutza en motziin otah mittachtav vehi keshera uveladah kasher. mippene shello gazru al sefek chalutza ella al chalutza vaddait. vechen mi shehayta sefek gerusha o sefek almana o sefek zona usefek chalala makkin oto makkat mardut umotzi beget: 
Kelal gadol hu bechol issurim shebbattora sheen issur chal al issur ella im ken hayu shene issurin bain keachat. o shehaya haissur haechad mosif devarim acherim al oto haissur. o im haya kolel devarim acherim im issur ze: 
Lefichach ishsha shehayta almana venaaset gerusha venaaset chalala venaaset zona uva aleha kohen gadol achar kach loke arba malkiyyot al bia achat. lefi shehaalmana asura lechohen gadol umutteret lehedyot. 
Chazra lihyot gerusha nosaf bah issur veneeseret lechohen hedyot. lefichach nosaf bah issur acher al issur haalmana vaadayin hi mutteret leechol bitruma. naaset chalala nosaf bah issur shehare neeseret bitruma vaadayin hi mutteret leyisrael. naaset zona hoil veyesh shem zenut sheosrah al yisrael im zinneta ishto beratzon nosaf bah issur acher. vehu haddin lechohen hedyot shebba al haggerusha shennaaset chalala veachar kach zona shehu loke shalosh al bia achat. aval im nishtanna seder ze eno loke ella achat: 
Mi shennitalmena meanashim harebe o nitgarsha meanashim harebe en lokin aleha ella achat al kol bia. almana ben min haerusin ben min hannissuin asura: 
Kohen gadol shemmet achiv af al pi shehu min haerusin hare ze lo yeyabbem ella choletz. nafla lo yevama vehu kohen hedyot venitmanna lihyot kohen gadol af al pi sheasa bah maamar keshehu kohen hedyot hare ze lo yeyabbem achar shennitmanna. aval im eres et haalmana venitmanna lihyot kohen gadol hare ze yichnos achar shennitmanna. hayta mekuddeshet sefek kiddushin umet arusah hare zo sefek almana: 
Mitzvat ase al kohen gadol sheyyissa naara betula. umishshettivgor teaser alav shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 13)</small> "vehu ishsha vivtuleha yikkach". ishsha lo ketanna. bivtuleha velo bogeret. ha ketzad. yatzat mikkelal katnut velichlal bagrut lo baa zo naara. veeno nose shete nashim leolam keachat shenneemar ishsha achat velo shetayim: 
Kohen gadol lo yissa mukkat etz af al pi shello nivala. [nivala shello kedarkah hare zo kenivala kedarkah. nivala livhema hare zo mutteret]: 
Kohen gadol shennasa beula eno loke aval motzi beget. nasa bogeret o mukkat etz hare ze yekayyem. eres beula venitmanna kohen gadol hare ze yichnos achar shennitmanna: 
Anas naara betula o pitta otah afillu anasah o pitta otah keshehu kohen hedyot venitmanna kohen gadol kodem sheyyichnos hare ze lo yichnos. veim kanas motzi: 
Eres et hakketanna uvagra tachtav kodem nissuin hare ze lo yichnos mippene shennishtanna gufah. veim kanas lo yotzi: 
Achat gerusha min haerusin o min hannissuin. aval hamemaenet afillu gershah beget vehechezirah umeana bo hare zo mutteret lechohen kemo shebbearnu behilchot gerushin. vechol mi sheenah reuya lachalitza im nechletza lo nifsela lichhunna: 
Yatza aleha kol ish peloni kohen katav get leishto o natan get leishto vahare hi yoshevet tachtav umeshammashto. en motziin otah mittachat balah. veim nisset lechohen acher tetze min hashsheni: 
Yatza shemah bair shennitkaddesha venitgarsha min hakkiddushin choshshin lah kemo shebbearnu behilchot gerushin. aval im yatza aleha kol shehi chalutza en choshshin lah: 
Yatza kol al habbetula shehi beula en choshshin lah vetinnase lechohen gadol. yatza aleha kol shehi shifcha en choshshin lah vetinnase afillu lechohen. yatza lah shem mezanna bair en choshshin lah. vaafillu hotziah balah mishshum sheavra al dat yehudit o beede davar mechoar umet kodem sheyyitten lah get hare zo mutteret lechohen. sheen osrin ishsha meellu ella beedut berura o bihodaat piha:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 18:
Mippi hashshemua lamadnu sheah <small>(Vayikra 21 7 14)</small> "zona" haamura battora hi kol sheenah bat yisrael. o bat yisrael shennivala leadam shehi asura lehinnase lo issur hashshave lakkol. o shennivala lechalal af al pi shehi mutteret lehinnase lo. lefichach hannirbaat livhema af al pi shehi biskila lo naaset zona velo nifsela lichhunna shehare lo nivala leadam. vehabba al hannidda af al pi shehi becharet lo naaset zona velo nifsela lichhunna shehare enah asura lehinnase lo: 
Vechen habba al happenuya afillu hayta kedesha shehifkira atzmah lakkol af al pi shehi bemalkot lo naaset zona velo nifsela min hakkehunna shehare enah asura lehinnase lo. aval hannivelet leechad meissure lavin hashshavin bakkol veen meyuchadin bechohanim. o meissure ase. veen tzarich lomar lemi shehi asura lo mishshum erva o leakkum veeved. hoil vehi asura lehinnase lo hare zo zona: 
Vechen haggiyyoret vehameshuchreret afillu nitgayyera venishtachrera pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim hoil veenah bat yisrael hare zo zona vaasura lechohen. mikkan amru akkum o natin o mamzer o ger ammoni umoavi o mitzri veedomi rishon vesheni o petzua dakka ucherut shafcha o chalal shebbau al hayyehudit asu otah zona venifsela lichhunna veim hayta kohenet pesaluha min hatteruma. vechen yevama shebba aleha zar asaah zona. vehaaylonit mutteret lechohen veenah zona: 
Habba al achat mehashsheniyyot vechayyotze bahen kegon habba al kerovat chalutzato o al chalutzato lo asa otah zona shehare enah asura lehinnase lo min hattora kemo shebbearnu behilchot yibbum: 
Ha lamadta sheen heyotah zona tole bivila shel issur. shehare habba al hannidda veal hakkedesha vehannirbaat labbehema nivala beila shel issur velo naaset zona. umi shennisset lechalal nivala beila shel hetter kemo sheyyitbaer venaaset zona veen haddavar taluy ella bifgima umippi hashshemua lamdu sheenah peguma ella meadam haasur lah o mechalal kemo sheamarnu: 
Kol hannivelet leadam sheose otah zona ben beones ben beratzon ben bezadon ben bishgaga [ben kedarkah ben shello kedarkah] mishsheheera bah nifsela mishshum zona. uvilvad shettihye bat shalosh shanim veyom echad veyihye habboel ben tesha shanim veyom echad vamala. lefichach eshet ish shennivala leacher ben beones ben beratzon nifsela lichhunna: 
Eshet kohen shenneensa balah loke aleha mishshum tuma shenneemar <small>(Devarim 24 4)</small> "lo yuchal balah harishon asher shillechah lashuv lekachtah lihyot lo leishsha achare asher hutammaa". hakkol bichlal sheim nivalu asurin al baalehen. peret lecha hakkatuv beeshet yisrael shenneensa shehi mutteret levalah shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 13)</small> "vehi lo nitpasa" aval eshet kohen beissurah omedet shehare hi zona: 
Eshet yisrael shenneensa af al pi shehi mutteret levalah asura lichhunna. eshet kohen sheamra levalah neenasti o shagagti uva alay echad o shebba ed echad veheid lo aleha shezzinneta ben beones ben beratzon hare zo enah asura alav. shemma eneha natna beacher. veim hi neemenet lo o haed neeman lo vesamach dato ledivrehem hare ze yotzi kede latzet yede safek: 
Eshet kohen sheamra levalah neenasti af al pi shehi mutteret levalah kemo shebbearnu hare hi asura lechol kohen shebbaolam achar sheyyamut balah. shehare hodet shehi zona veasra atzmah venaaset kachaticha haasura: 
Kohen shekkiddesh gedola o ketanna veachar zeman ba aleha vetaan shemmetzaah derusat ish neesra alav missafek shemma kodem kiddushin nivala o achar kiddushin. aval yisrael shettaan taana zo lo neesra alav sheyyesh kan shene sefekot shemma kodem kiddushin veshemma achar kiddushin. vaafillu nomar leachar kiddushin shemma beones shemma beratzon. shehaanusa mutteret leyisrael kemo shebbearnu: 
Lefichach im kiddeshah aviha leyisrael vehi pechuta mibbat shalosh shanim veyom echad vetaan shemmetzaah derusat ish neesra alav missafek sheen kan ella safek echad shemma beones shemma beratzon vesafek issur shel tora lechumra: 
Kol ishsha shekkinne lah balah venistera velo shatat me sota asura lechohen mippene shehi sefek zona. ben shello ratzat hi lishtot. ben shello ratza lehashekotah. ben shehayta sham edut shemmonah millishtot. ben shekkinneu lah bet din. ben shehayta min hannashim sheen reuyot lishtot. hoil velo shatat mikkol makom hare zo asura lichhunna missafek: 
Penuya sherauha shennivala leechad vehalach lo veamru lah mi hu ze shebba alayich veamra adam kasher hare zo neemenet. velo od ella afillu rauha meubberet veamru lah mimmi nitabbart veamra meadam kasher hare zo neemenet vetihye mutteret lechohen: 
Bamme devarim amurim besheyyihye hammakom shennivala bo parashat derachim o bikranot shebbassadot shehakkol ovrin sham. vehayu rov haovrim sham kesherim verov hair shepparshu ellu haovrin mimmenna kesherim. shehachachamim asu maala beyuchasin vehitzrichu shene rubbot. aval im hayu rov haovrim poslim otah kegon akkum o mamzerim vechayyotze bahem af al pi sherov hammakom shebbau mimmenna kesherim o shehayu rov anshe hammakom pesulin af al pi sherov haovrin sham kesherim choshshin lah shemma lemi shepposel otah nivala velo tinnase lechohen lechattechilla. veim nisset (lo) tetze: 
Rauha shennivala bair o nitabbera bair afillu lo haya shochen sham ella akkum echad o chalal echad veeved vechayyotze bahen hare zo lo tinnase lechattechilla lechohen. shekkol hakkavua kemechetza al mechetza hu. veim nisset lo tetze hoil vehi omeret lechasher nivalti: 
Hayta illemet o chereshet o sheamra eni yodaat lemi nivalti o shehayta ketanna sheenah makkeret ben kasher lefasul hare zo sefek zona. veim nisset lechohen tetze ella im ken hayu shene harubbin hammetzuyin etzlah kesherim: 
Hashshevuya shennifdet vehi bat shalosh shanim veyom echad o yeter asura lechohen mippene shehi sefek zona shemma nivala leakkum. veim yesh lah ed shello nityached haakkum immah hare zo keshera lichhunna. vaafillu eved o shifcha o karov neeman leedut zo. ushete shevuyot sheheida kol achat mehen lachavertah hare ellu neemanot. hoil veissur kol hassefekot kullan middivre sofrim lefichach hekellu bishvuya: 
Vechen katan shehaya mesiach lefi tummo neeman. maase beechad shennishba hu veimmo uvenah mesiach lefi tummo veamar nishbenu leven haakkum ani veimmi yatzati lishov mayim vedati al immi lilkot etzim vedati al immi. vehissiu otah chachamim lechohen al piv: 
En habbaal neeman lehaid beishto hashshevuya shello nitmea. sheen adam meid leatzmo. vechen shifchatah lo taid lah. aval shifchat balah meida lah. veshifchatah shehayta mesicha lefi tummah neemenet: 
Kohen sheheid lishvuya shehi tehora hare ze lo yissaenna shemma enav natan bah. veim pedaah veheid bah hare ze yissaenna. sheillu lo yada shehi tehora lo natan bah meotav: 
Haishsha sheamra nishbeti utehora ani neemenet shehappe sheasar hu happe shehittir afillu haya sham ed echad shemmeid shehi shevuya. aval im yesh sham shene edim shennishbet enah neemenet ad sheyyaid lah echad shehi tehora. hayu sham shene edim shennishbet veed echad meid shennitmet veechad machchish oto umeid lah shehi tehora velo nityached immah akkum ad shennifdet. afillu ze shemmeid shehi tehora ishsha o shifcha hare zo mutteret: 
Mi sheamra nishbeti utehora ani vehittiruha bet din lehinnase veachar kach bau shene edim shennishbet hare zo tinnase lechattechilla velo tetze mehetterah. vaafillu nichnas achareha shabbay vahare hi shevuya lefanenu beyad adoneha hare zo lo tetze mehetterah shehittiruha. umeshammerin otah meatta ad shettippade: 
Bau lah shene edim achar kach shennitmet afillu nisset vaafillu hayu lah banim hare zo tetze. veim ba ed echad eno kelum. amra nishbeti utehora ani veyesh li edim sheani tehora en omrin namtin ad sheyyavou haedim ella mattirin otah miyyad. velo od ella afillu yatza aleha kol sheyyesh aleha ede tuma mattirin otah ad sheyyavou. shebbishvuya hekellu: 
Haav sheamar kiddashti et bitti vegerashtiha vahare hi ketanna neeman. kiddashtiha vegerashtiha keshehayta ketanna vahare hi gedola eno neeman lehachazikah gerusha. nishbet ufeditiha ben shehi gedola ben shehi ketanna eno neeman. shello heemina oto tora ella leasrah mishshum ishut shenneemar <small>(Devarim 22 16)</small> "et bitti natatti laish hazze". aval lo lefaslah mishshum zenut: 
Eshet kohen shenneesra alav mishshum shevuya hoil vehaddavar safek hare zo mutteret ladur immo bechatzer echad uvilvad sheyyihyu immo banav uvene beto tamid leshamro: 
Ir shebbaa bematzor venichbesha im hayu haakkum makkifin et hair mikkol ruchoteha kede shello timmalet ishsha achat ad sheyyiru otah vetease birshutan hare kol hannashim shebbetochah pesulot lichhunna kishvuyot shemma nivalu leakkum. ella mi shehayta mibbat shalosh shanim ulematta kemo shebbearnu: 
Veim haya efshar shettimmalet ishsha achat velo yedu bah o shettihye bair machavoa achat afillu enah machzeket ella ishsha achat hare zo matztzelet al hakkol: 
Ketzad matztzelet. shekkol ishsha sheamra tehora ani neemenet. veaf al pi sheen lah ed mittoch sheyyechola lomar nimlatti keshennichbesha hair o bemachavoa hayiti venitztzalti neemenet lomar lo nimlatti velo nechbeti velo nitmeti: 
Bamme devarim amurim bigdud shel otah malchut shehem mityashshevin bair veen yerein lefichach choshshin lahem shemma baalu. aval gedud shel malchut acheret sheppashat veshataf veavar lo neesru hannashim mippene sheen lahem penay livol shehen oskim bashshalal uvorchin lahem. veim shavu nashim venaasu birshutan af al pi sheradfu acharehem yisrael vehitztzilu otan miyyadam hare hen asurot: 
Haishsha shenechbesha beyad akkum al yede mamon mutteret. al yede nefashot asura lichhunna ulefichach im haya balah kohen neesra alav. bamme devarim amurim bizman sheyyad yisrael takkifa al haakkum vehem yerein mehem. aval bizman sheyyad haakkum takkifa afillu al yede mamon kevan shennaaset birshut haakkum neesra ella im ken heid lah echad kishvuya kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 19: E zo hi chalala zo shennolida meissur kehunna. vechen achat min hannashim haasurot lichhunna shennivala lechohen nitchallela. aval hakkohen atzmo sheavar haavera lo nitchallel:

Uven shennivala beones o bishgaga [ben kedarkah ben shello kedarkah] mishsheheera bah nitchallela. vehu sheyyihye kohen ben tesha shanim veyom echad vamala vetihye zo haasura lo bat shalosh shanim veyom echad vamala:

Ketzad. kohen ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al haggerusha o al hazzona. vechohen gadol shebba alehen o al haalmana o shennasa beula uva aleha hare ellu nitchallelu leolam. veim holid mimmenna ben ben ze shechillelah ben kohen achar havvalad chalal. aval kohen shekkiddesh ishsha meissure kehunna venitalmena o nitgarsha min haerusin lo nitchallela. veim nisset af al pi shello nivala nitchallela shekkol nesua bechezkat beula hi af al pi shennimtzet betula:
Kohen gadol shennasa bogeret o mukkat etz lo chillelah. vechen im baal beula belo nissuin lo chillelah:

Kohen habba al erva min haarayot chutz minnidda o al achat mechayyave lavin hashshavin bakkol asa otah zona kemo shebbearnu. chazar uva aleha bia sheniyya ben hu ben kohen acher naaset chalala vezaro mimmenna chalalim. lefichach kohen shebba al zekuka leyavam venitabbera mibbia rishona havvalad kasher lefi sheenah meissure kehunna venaaset zona. chazar uva aleha bia sheniyya venitabbera veyalda hi chalala uveladah chalal lefi shehu meissure kehunna:
Vechen kohen habba al haggiyyoret vehameshuchreret chillelah vezaro mimmenna chalalim. kohen habba al hannidda havvalad kasher veeno chalal sheen issur hannidda meyuchad bechohanim ella shave bakkol:
Kohen shennasa gerusha meubberet ben mimmennu ben meacher veyalda keshehi chalala havvalad kasher shehare lo ba mittippat avera:

Kevar bearnu shehachalutza asura lechohen middivrehem. lefichach kohen shebba al hachalutza hare zo chalala vezarah mikkohen chalalim vehakkol middivrehen. aval kohen shebba al achat mehashsheniyyot hi keshera vezaro mimmenna kesherim. sheissur hashsheniyyot issur hashshave bakkol hu veeno meyuchad bechohanim:
Kohen shebba al sefek zona kegon sefek giyyoret o meshuchreret. o shebba al sefek gerusha. vechen kohen gadol shebba al sefek almana hare zo sefek chalala uveladah sefek chalal:

Nimtzeu hachalalim shelosha. chalal min hattora. vechalal middivrehem. usefek chalal. vechol sefek chalal notnin alav chumre kohanim vechumre yisrael. eno ochel bitruma velo mittamme lammetim venose ishsha haruya lechohen. veim achal o nitma o nasa gerusha makkin oto makkat mardut. vehu haddin bechalal shel divrehem. aval chalal shel tora havvadday hare hu kezar venose gerusha umittamme lammetim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 1)</small> "emor el hakkohanim bene aharon". af al pi shehem bene aharon ad sheyyihyu bechihunam:

Kohen zachar shehu asur lissa zona vachalala asur begiyyoret umeshuchreret shehi kezona kemo shebbearnu. aval hakkohenet mutteret lehinnase lechalal uleger velimshuchrar shello huzharu kesherot lehinnase lifsulin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 21 1)</small> "bene aharon" velo benot aharon. nimtza hagger muttar lissa mamzeret velissa kohenet:

Gerim umeshuchrarim shennasu ellu meellu veholidu bat afillu leachar kamma dorot hoil velo nitarev bahen zera yisrael hare otah habbat asura lechohen. veim nisset lo tetze hoil vehoratah veledatah bikdushsha. aval ger o meshuchrar shennasa bat yisrael o yisrael shennasa giyyoret o meshuchreret bitto keshera lichhunna lechattechilla:
Ger ammoni shennasa bat yisrael vechen mitzri sheni shennasa bat yisrael af al pi shebbiatam baavera vahare neshotehen zonot kemo shebbearnu benotehem kesherot lichhunna lechattechilla:

Chalal shennasa keshera zaro mimmenna chalalim. vechen ben ben beno vaafillu achar elef dor. shebben hechalal hazzachar hu chalal leolam. veim hayta bat asura hi lichhunna shehare hi chalala. aval yisrael shennasa chalala havvalad kasher. lefichach im hayta bat hare zo tinnase lichhunna lechattechilla:

Kohanim uleviyyim veyisreelim muttarin lavo ze baze. vehavvalad holech achar hazzachar. (leviyyim veyisreelim vachalalim muttarim lavo ze baze vehavvalad holech achar hazzachar). shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 1 18)</small> "vayyityaldu al mishpechotam levet avotam". bet aviv hi mishpachto veen bet immo mishpachto:

Leviyyim veyisreelim vachalalim gerim vaavadim meshuchrarim muttarim lavo ze baze. vehagger vehameshuchrar shennasa leviyya o yisreelit o chalala hare habben yisreeli. veyisreeli o levi o chalal shennasu giyyoret o meshuchreret havvalad holech achar hazzachar:

Kol mishpachot bechezkat kesherot umuttar lissa mehen lechattechilla. veaf al pi chen im raita shete mishpachot shemmitgarot zo bazo tamid o raita mishpacha shehi baalat matztza umeriva tamid. o raita ish shehu marbe meriva im hakkol veaz panim beyoter. choshshin lahen verauy lehitrachek mehen sheellu simane paslut hem. vechen happosel et acherim tamid. kegon shennoten shemetz bemishpachot o bichidim veomer alehen shehen mamzerim. choshshin lo shemma mamzer hu. veim amar lahen shehem avadim choshshin lo shemma eved hu. shekkol happosel bemumo posel. vechen kol mi sheyyesh bo azzut panim o achzariyyut vesone et habberiyyot veeno gomel lahem chesed choshshin lo beyoter shemma givoni hu. shessimane yisrael haumma hakkedosha bayshanin rachamanim vegomle chasadim. uvaggivonim hu omer <small>(Shmuel 2 21 2)</small> "vehaggivonim lo mibbene yisrael hemma" lefi sheheezzu penehem velo nitpayyesu velo richamu al bene shaul velo gamlu leyisrael chesed limchol livne malkam vehem asu immahem chesed vehecheyum battechilla:

Mishpacha shekkara aleha arar vehu sheyyaidu shenayim shennitarev bahen mamzer o chalal o sheyyesh bahen avdut hare ze safek. veim mishpachat kohanim hi lo yissa mimmenna ishsha ad sheyyivdok aleha arba immahot shehen shemone. immah. veem immah. veem avi immah. veem em avi immah. vechen hu bodek al em aviha. veem em aviha. veem avi aviha. veem em avi aviha:
Veim hayta mishpacha zo shekkara aleha arar leviyyim o yisreelim. mosif livdok lahem zug echad. venimtza bodek eser immahot. shehaeruv balviyyim veyisreelim yeter min hakkohanim:

Velamma bodek bannashim bilvad. mippene shehaanashim kol et sheyyarivu ze im ze yecharef et chavero bifsul sheyyesh beyichuso. veillu haya sham pasul haya nishma. aval hannashim en mecharfot beyuchasin:
Velamma yivdok haish kesheyyirtze lissa mimmishpacha zo shehura chezkatah velo tivdok ishsha shettinnase lahen. mippene shello huzharu kesherot lehinnase lifsulin:
Kol shekkorin lo mamzer veshotek. o natin veshotek. o chalal veshotek. o eved veshotek. choshshin lo ulemishpachto veen nosin mehen ella im ken bodkin kemo shebbearnu:

Mishpacha shennitarev bah sefek chalal kol almana meotah mishpacha asura lechohen lechattechilla. veim nisset lo tetze mippene shehen shete sefekot. shemma zo almenat oto chalal shemma enah almenato. veim nomar shehi almenato shemma chalal hu shemma eno chalal. aval im nitarev bah chalal vadday kol ishsha mehen asura lechohen ad sheyyivdok. veim nisset tetze. vehu haddin im nitarev bah sefek mamzer o mamzer vadday. sheeshet mamzer veeshet chalal lichhunna issur echad hu kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 20:
Kol kohanim bazzeman hazze bachazaka hem kohanim veen ochlin ella bekadshe haggevul. vehu shettihye teruma shel divrehem. aval teruma shel tora vechalla shel tora en ochel otah ella kohen meyuchas: 
E zehu kohen meyuchas kol sheheidu lo shene edim shehu kohen ben peloni hakkohen ufeloni ben peloni hakkohen ad ish sheeno tzarich bedika vehu hakkohen sheshshimmesh al gabbe hammizbeach. sheillu lo badku bet din haggadol acharav lo hayu menichin oto laavod. lefichach en bodkin mehammizbeach vamala velo min hassanhedrin vamala. sheen memannin bassanhedrin ella kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim meyuchasin: 
Challa bazzeman hazze vaafillu beeretz yisrael enah shel tora shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 18)</small> "bevoachem el haaretz" biat kullechem velo biat miktzatchem. ucheshealu bime ezra lo alu kullam. vechen teruma bazzeman hazze shel divre sofrim ulefichach ochlim otah hakkohanim shebbizmannenu shehen bachazaka: 
Mi sheheidu alav [shene] edim sherauhu shehaya ochel bitruma shel tora hare ze meyuchas. veen maalin leyuchasin lo minnesiat kappayim velo mikkeria battora rishon velo mechilluk teruma bevet haggeranot velo al pi ed echad: 
Kohen meyuchas sheamar beni ze kohen hu en maalin oto leyuchasin al piv ad sheyyavi edim shehu beno: 
Kohen meyuchas sheyyatza hu veishto sheyyadanu shehi keshera limdina acheret uva hu vehi uvanim keruchin acharehen veamar ishsha sheyyatzat immi hi zo veellu baneha eno tzarich lehavi edim lo al haishsha velo al habbanim. meta veellu baneha tzarich lehavi edim sheellu banav. veeno tzarich lehavi edim al imman shehi keshera. mippene shekkevar huchzak sheyyatza meimmanu keishsha keshera: 
Yatza kohen meyuchas limdina acheret uva hu veishto uvanav veamar ishsha zo nasati veellu baneha tzarich lehavi reaya sheishsha zo keshera. veeno mevi edim sheellu baneha. vehu sheyyihyu keruchin achareha. veim ba bishte nashim vehevi reaya al haachat af al pi shehabbanim ketannim ucheruchin achareha tzarich lehavi reaya alehem shemma banav min haacheret hem venichrechu achar zo hameyucheset: 
Ba hu uvanav veamar ishsha nasati vameta veellu baneha mevi edim sheotah haishsha keshera hayta veellu baneha. vechaddin hazze danin beyisrael meyuchas uvelevi meyuchas. veachar kach naid al beno ze shehu meyuchas kede sheyyihye rauy lesanhedrin: 
En maalin mishshetarot lichhunna. ketzad. hare shehaya katuv bishtar peloni kohen lava mippeloni vehilvahu kach vechach vehaedim millematta en machazikin bahem kohen ze shehu meyuchas shemma lo heidu ella al hammilve. bamme devarim amurim leinyan yichus. aval lachazaka sheyyihye kohen kechohane zeman ze veyochal teruma vechalla shel divre sofrim uvishar kadshe haggevul maalin min hashshetarot veal pi ed echad uminnesiut kappayim umikkeria battora rishon: 
Vechen kol kohen sheamar beni ze kohen neeman lehaachilo bitruma velihyoto bechezkat kohen veeno tzarich lehavi reaya lo al habbanim velo al haishsha: 
Shenayim shebbau limdina ze omer ani vachaveri kohen veze omer ani vachaveri kohen af al pi shennirin kegomlin ze et ze hare ellu neemanin ushenehem bechezkat kohanim. vechen ed sheamar raiti ze shennasa kappav o sheachal bitruma o shechalak al haggoren o shekkara battora rishon vekara acharav levi machazikin oto bichhunna al piv. vechen im heid shezze kara sheni battora achar kohen machazikin oto bilviyya: 
Heid sheraa ze shechalak im achiv bevet din teruma shehinniach lahen avihen hakkohen en maalin oto lichhunna beedut zo. shemma chalal hu velakach chelek yerushshato mitteruma lemachrah: 
Mi shebba bazzeman hazze veamar kohen ani eno neeman veen maalin oto lichhunna al pi atzmo velo yikra battora rishon velo yissa et kappav velo yochal bekadshe haggevul ad sheyyihye lo ed echad. aval oser atzmo bigrusha vezona vachalala veeno mittamme lemetim. veim nasa o nitma loke. vehannivelet lo sefek chalala: 
Veim haya mesiach lefi tummo neeman. ketzad. maase beechad shehaya mesiach lefi tummo veamar zachur ani keshehayiti tinok vehayiti murkav al ketefo shel avi hotziuni mibbet hassefer vehifshituni kuttanti vehitbiluni leechol teruma laerev vachaveray bodlin mimmenni vehayu korin oti yochanan ochel challot veheelahu rabbenu hakkadosh lichhunna al pi atzmo: 
Neeman gadol lomar zachur ani keshehayiti tinok veraiti peloni tovel veochel bitruma laerev umachazikin oto bichhunna beeduto. mi shebba bazzeman hazze veamar kohen ani veed echad meid lo sheani yodea sheaviv shel ze kohen en maalin oto lichhunna beedut ze shemma chalal hu ad sheyyaid shezze kohen hu. aval im huchzak aviv kohen o shebbau shenayim veheidu sheaviv shel ze kohen hare hu bechezkat aviv: 
Mi shehuchzak aviv kohen veyatza alav kol shehu ben gerusha o chalutza choshshin lo umoridin oto. ba ed echad achar kach veheid shehu kasher maalin oto lichhunna al piv. bau shenayim edim achar kach vehaidu shehu chalal moridin oto min hakkehunna. ba ed echad veheid shehu kasher maalin oto lichhunna shezze haacharon mitztaref leed rishon vahare shenayim meidin shehu kasher ushenayim meidim shehu pasul yiddachu ellu veellu veyiddache hakkol shehashshenayim kemea veyishshaer kohen bechezkat aviv: 
Ishsha shello shahata shelosha chodashim achar balah veyalda. veen yadua im ben tisha lerishon o ben shiva leacharon vehaya echad mehen kohen vehashsheni yisrael hare ze sefek kohen. vechach im nitarev velad kohen bivlad yisrael vehigdilu hattaarovot kol echad mehen sefek kohen. venotnin alehen chumre yisrael vechumre kohanim. nosin nashim haruyot lichhunna veen mittammeim lemetim velo ochlin bitruma. veim nasu gerusha motziin veenan lokin: 
Shene kohanim shennitarvu valdotehem. o eshet kohen shello shahata achar balah shelosha chodashim venisset lechohen acher veen yadua im ben tisha larishon o ben shiva laacharon. notnin lo al havvalad chumre shenehem. hu onen alehem vehen onnin alav. hu en metamme lahem vehem enan metammein lo. veole bemishmaro shel ze veshel ze. veen cholek. veim hayu shenehem bemishmar echad uvet av echad notel chelek echad: 
Bamme devarim amurim bizman shehen bain mikkoach nissuin. aval biznut gazru chachamim shemmeshattekin oto middin kehunna kelal hoil veeno yodea aviv havvadday shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 25 13)</small> "vehayta lo ulezaro acharav" ad sheyyihye zaro meyuchas acharav: 
Ketzad. asara kohanim shepperash echad mehem uvaal shehare havvalad kohen vadday veaf al pi chen hoil veeno yodea aviv sheyyityaches lo meshattekin oto middin kehunna. veeno oved velo ochel velo cholek. veim nitma lemetim o nasa gerusha loke sheen kan sefek hetter:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 21:
Kol habba al erva min haarayot derech evarim o shechibbek venishshek derech taava venehena bekeruv basar hare ze loke min hattora. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 18 30)</small> "levilti asot mechukkot hattoevot" vegomer. veneemar <small>(Vayikra 18 6)</small> "lo tikrevu legallot erva". kelomar lo tikrevu lidvarim hammeviin lide gilluy erva: 
Haose davar mechukkot ellu hare hu chashud al haarayot. veasur laadam likrotz beyadav uveraglav o lirmoz beenav leachat min haarayot o lischok immah o lehakel rosh. vaafillu lehariach besamim shealeha o lehabbit beyafyah asur. umakkin lammitkavven ledavar ze makkat mardut. vehammistakkel afillu beetzba ketanna shel ishsha venitkavven lehanot kemi shennistakkel bimkom hattoref. vaafillu lishmoa kol haerva o lirot searah asur: 
Vehaddevarim haellu asurin bechayyave lavin. umuttar lehistakkel bifne happenuya ulevadkah ben betula ben beula kede sheyyire im hi naa beenav yissaenna veen baze tzad issur velo od ella sherauy laasot ken. aval lo yistakkel derech zenut. hare hu omer <small>(Iyov lo 1)</small> "berit karatti leenay uma etbonen al betula": 
Umuttar laadam lehabbit beishto keshehi nidda veaf al pi shehi erva. veaf al pi sheyyesh lo hanaat lev mimmenna biriyya hoil vehi mutteret lo leachar zeman eno ba baze lidvar michshol. aval lo yischok velo yakel rosh immah shemma yargil laavera: 
Asur lehishtamesh beishsha kelal ben gedola ben ketanna ben shifcha ben meshuchreret shemma yavo lide hirhur. bee ze shimmush amru rechitzat panav yadav veraglav vehatztzaat mitta lefanav umezigat hakkos. sheen osa leish devarim ellu ella ishto bilvad. veen shoalin bishlom ishsha kelal vaafillu al yede shaliach: 
Hamechabbek achat min haarayot sheen libbo shel adam nokfo alehen o shennishshek leachat mehen kegon achoto haggedola vaachot immo vechayyotze bahen af al pi sheen sham taava velo hanaa kelal hare ze megunne beyoter vedavar asur hu umaase tippeshim hu. sheen kerevin leerva kelal ben gedola ben ketanna chutz mehaem livnah vehaav levitto: 
Ketzad. muttar haav lechabbek bitto ulenashshekah vetishan immo bekeruv basar. vechen haem im benah kol zeman shehem ketannim. higdilu venaasa habben gadol vehabbat gedola ad sheyyihyu shadayim nachonu usearech tzamach ze yashen bichsuto vehi yeshena bichsutah. veim hayta habbat bosha laamod lifne aviha arumma o shennisset. vechen im haem bosha laamod bifne benah arumma veaf al pi shehen ketannim mishshehiggiu lehikkalem mehen en yeshenim immahem ella bichsutan: 
Nashim hamesolalot zo bazo asur umimmaase mitzrayim hu shehuzharnu alav shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 18 3)</small> "kemaase eretz mitzrayim lo taasu". amru chachamim me hayu osim ish nose ish veishsha nose ishsha. veishsha nisset lishne anashim. af al pi shemmaase ze asur en malkin alav. sheen lo lav meyuchad vahare en sham bia kelal. lefichach en neesarot lichhunna mishshum zenut velo teaser ishsha al balah baze sheen kan zenut. verauy lehakkotan makkat mardut hoil veasu issur. veyesh laish lehakepid al ishto middavar ze umonea hannashim hayeduot bechach millehikkanes lah umillatzet hi alehen: 
Ishto shel adam mutteret hi lo. lefichach kol ma sheadam rotze laasot beishto ose. boel bechol et sheyyirtze umenashshek bechol evar veevar sheyyirtze. [uva aleha kedarkah veshello kedarkah ] uvilvad shello yotzi shichvat zera levattala. veaf al pi chen middat chasidut shello yakel adam et rosho lechach vesheyyekaddesh atzmo bishat tashmish kemo shebbearnu behilchot deot. velo yasur midderech haolam uminhago sheen davar ze ella kede lifrot velirbot: 
Asur laadam leshammesh mittato leor hanner. hare shehayta shabbat velo haya lo bayit acher vehaya hanner daluk hare ze lo yeshammesh kelal. vechen asur leyisreeli leshammesh mittato bayyom. sheazzut panim hi lo. veim haya talmid chacham sheeno ba lehimmashech bechach hare ze maafil betallito umeshammesh. veen nizkakin ledavar ze ella mippene tzorech gadol. vederech kedushsha leshammesh beemtza hallayla: 
En daat chachamim nocha lemi shehu marbe battashmish hammitta veyihye matzuy etzel ishto ketarnegol. ufagum hu ad meod umaase burim hu. ella kol hamemaet battashmish hare ze meshubbach. vehu shello yevattel ona [ella] middaat ishto. velo tikkenu barishona levaale kerayin shello yikreu battora ad sheyyitbelu ella kede lemaet battashmish hammitta: 
Vechen asru chachamim shello yeshammesh adam mittato velibbo mechashshev beishsha acheret. velo yivol mittoch shichrut velo mittoch meriva velo mittoch sina velo yavo aleha al karchah vehi yerea mimmennu. velo kesheyyihye echad mehen menudde. velo yavo aleha achar sheggamar belibbo legarshah. veim asa ken habbanim enan hagunim ella mehen azze panim umehen mordim ufoshim: 
Vechen amru chachamim shekkol ishsha chatzufa shehi tovaat tashmish hammitta befiha. o hamefatte ishshah leshem nissuin. o hammitkavven lavo al rachel ishto uva al lea ishto. umi shello shahata achar mitat balah shelosha chodashim vahare habben safek. kol ellu habbanim hayyillodim mehem hem hammordim vehapposhim sheyyissure haggalut borrin otan: 
Veasur leadam lavo al ishto bashshevakim uvarchovot o baggannot uvappardesin ella bevet dira. shello yerae kiznut veyargilu atzmam lide zenut. vehabboel et ishto bimkomot ellu makkin oto makkat mardut. vechen hamekaddesh bevia vehamekaddesh bashshuk vehamekaddesh belo shidduch makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Veachsenay asur battashmish hammitta ad sheyyachzor leveto. vechen asru chachamim al haish sheyyadur bevet chamiv shezzo azzut panim hi. velo yikkanes immo lemerchatz: 
Velo yikkanes adam im aviv lammerchatz. velo im baal achoto. velo im talmido. veim haya tzarich letalmido muttar. veyesh mekomot shennahagu shello yikkansu shene achim keechad lammerchatz: 
Lo yehallechu benot yisrael perue rosh bashshuk. achat penuya veachat eshet ish. velo telech ishsha bashshuk uvenah achareha gezera shemma yitpesu benah vetelech acharav lehachaziro veyitallelu bah harshaim shettefasuhu derech sechok: 
Asur lehotzi shichvat zera levattala. lefichach lo yihye adam dash mibbifnim vezore mibbachutz. velo yissa ketanna sheenah reuya leled. aval ellu shemmenaafin bayyad umotziin shichvat zera lo day lahem sheissur gadol hu ella shehaose ze benidduy hu yoshev vaalehem neemar <small>(yeshaya 1 15)</small> "yedechem damim maleu" ucheillu harag hannefesh: 
Vechen asur leadam sheyyakshe atzmo ledaat o yavi atzmo lide hirhur. ella im yavo lo hirhur yassia libbo middivre havay (vehashechata) ledivre tora. shehi <small>(Mishlei 5 19)</small> "ayyelet ahavim veyaalat chen". lefichach asur leadam lishon al arpo ufanav lemala ad sheyyitte meat kede shello yavo lide kishshuy: 
Velo yistakkel bivhema uvechayya veof beshaa shemmizdakkin zachar linkeva. vmuttar lemarbie behema lehachenis kemichchol bishfoferet mippene shehen asukin bimlachtan lo yavou lide hirhur: 
Vechen asur leadam lehistakkel benashim beshaa shehen omdot al hakkevisa. afillu lehistakkel bevigde tzemer shel ishsha shehu makkirah asur. shello yavo lide hirhur: 
Mi sheppaga beishsha bashshuk asur lo lehallech achareha ella ratz umesallekah latztzedadin o leacharav. vechol hamehallech bashshuk achare ishsha hare ze mikkalle amme haaretz. veasur laavor al petach ishsha zona ad sheyyarchik arba ammot shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 5 8)</small> "veal tikrav el petach betah": 
Veasur leadam sheeno nasuy lishloach yado bimvushav shello yavo lide hirhur. vaafillu mittachat tibburo lo yachnis yado shemma yavo lide hirhur. veim hishtin mayim lo yeechoz baamma veyashtin. veim haya nasuy muttar. uven nasuy uven sheeno nasuy lo yoshit yado laamma kelal ella beshaa shehu tzarich linkavav: 
Chasidim harishonim ugedole hachachamim hitpaer echad mehem shemmeolam lo nistakkel bammila shello. umehen mi shehitpaer shello hitbonen meolam betzurat ishto. mippene shellibbo pone middivre havay ledivre haemet shehen ochazot levav hakkedoshim: 
Mitzvat chachamim sheyyassi adam banav uvenotav samuch lefirkan. sheim yannichan yavou lide zenut o lide hirhur. veal ze neemar <small>(Iyov 5 24)</small> "ufakadta navcha velo techeta". veasur lehassi ishsha lekatan shezze kemo zenut hi: 
Veen haish rashshay leshev belo ishsha. velo yissa akara uzekena sheenah reuya leled. ureshut laishsha shello tinnase leolam o tinnase lesaris. velo yissa bachur zekena velo yissa zaken yalda sheddavar ze gorem liznut: 
Vechen mi sheggeresh et ishto min hannissuin lo tadur immo bechatzer shemma yavou lide zenut. veim haya kohen lo tadur immo bemavoy. uchefar katan niddon kemavoy. haya lah milve etzlo osa shaliach letavo. ugerusha shebbaa im hamegaresh laddin menaddin otan o makkin otan makkat mardut. veim nitgarsha min haerusin mutteret letavo baddin veladur immo. veim haya libbo gas bah af min haerusin asur. umi nidche mippene mi hi niddechet mippanav. veim hayta hechatzer shellah hu yiddache mippaneha: 
Asur leadam lissa ishsha vedato legarshah shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 3 29)</small> "al tacharosh al reacha raa vehu yoshev lavetach ittach". veim hodia battechilla shehu nose otah leyamim muttar: 
Velo yissa adam ishsha bimdina zo veishsha bimdina acheret shemma yaarichu hayyamim venimtza ach nose achoto vaachot immo vaachot aviv vechayyotze bahen veeno yadua. veim haya adam gadol sheshshemo yadua vahare zaro mefursamin viduin hare ze muttar: 
Lo yissa adam ishsha mimmishpachat metzoraim velo mimmishpachat nichpin. vehu shehuchzeku shelosha peamim sheyyavou benehem kach: 
Ishsha shennisset lishne anashim vametu. lishlishi lo tinnase veim nisset lo tetze. vaafillu nitkaddesha yichnos. velo yissa yisrael am haaretz kohenet shezze kemo chillul lezaro shel aharon. veim nasa amru chachamim en ziuugan ole yafe ella met belo banim o met hu o hi bimhera o ketata tihye benehem. aval talmid chacham shennasa kohenet hare ze nae umeshubbach. hare tora uchehunna keechad: 
Lo yissa adam bat amme haaretz sheim met o gole banav amme haaretz yihyu sheen imman yodaat keter hattora. velo yassi bitto leam haaretz shekkol hannoten bitto leam haaretz kemiyi shekkefatah unetanah lifne haari makke uvoel veen lo boshet panim. uleolam yimkor adam kol ma sheyyesh lo veyissa bat talmid chacham sheim met o gole banav talmide chachamim. vechen yassi bitto letalmid chacham sheen davar megunne velo meriva beveto shel talmid chacham:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 22:
Asur lehityached im erva min haarayot ben zekena ben yalda sheddavar ze gorem legallot erva. chutz mehaem im benah vehaav im bitto vehabbaal im ishto nidda. vechatan sheppersa ishto nidda kodem sheyyivol asur lehityached immah ella hi yeshena ben hannashim vehu yashen ben haanashim. veim ba aleha bia rishona veachar kach nitmet muttar lehityached immah: 
Lo nechshedu yisrael al mishkav zachur veal habbehema. lefichach en asur lehityached immahen. veim nitrachek afillu miyyichud zachur uvehema hare ze meshubbach. ugedole hachachamim hayu marchikin habbehema kede shello yityachadu immah. veissur yichud haarayot mippi hakkabbala: 
Kesheera maase amnon vetamar gazar david uvet dino al yichud penuya. veaf al pi sheenah erva bichlal yichud arayot hi. veshammay vehillel gazru al yichud kutit. nimtza kol hammityached im ishsha sheasur lehityached immah ben yisreelit ben kutit makkin et shenehen makkat mardut haish vehaishsha. umachrizin alehen. chutz meeshet ish sheaf al pi sheasur lehityached immah im nityached en lokin. shello lehotzi laaz aleha shezzinneta venimtzeu motziin laaz al habbanim shehen mamzerim: 
Kol ishsha sheasur lehityached immah im hayta ishto immo hare zo mutteret lehityached mippene sheishto meshammarto. aval lo tityached yisreelit im hakkuti veaf al pi sheishto immo sheen ishto shel kuti meshammarto veen lahen busha: 
Vechen en mosrin tinok yisrael lechuti lelammedo sefer ulelammedo ammanut. mippene shekkullan chashudin al mishkav zachur. veen maamidin behema befundakiyyot shel kutim vaafillu zecharim etzel zecharim unekevot etzel nekevot: 
Veen mosrin behema chayya veof leroe kuti afillu zecharim lechutim unekevot lechutit mippene shekkullan chashudin al harebaat behema uchevar bearnu shehen asurin bezachur uvivhema veneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 14)</small> "velifne ivver lo titten michshl": 
Umippene ma en mosrin behema nekeva lechutit mippene shekkullan bechezkat noafim uchesheyyavo hannoef lishkav im hakkutit zo efshar shello yimtzaenna veyishkav im habbehema o afillu yimtzaenna yishkav im habbehema: 
Lo tityached ishsha achat afillu im anashim harebe ad shettihye ishto shel echad mehem sham. vechen lo yityached ish echad afillu im nashim harebe. nashim harebe im anashim harebe en choshshin leyichud. hayu haanashim mibbachutz vehannashim mibbifnim o haanashim mibbifnim vehannashim mibbachutz ufersha ishsha achat leven haanashim o ish leven hannashim asurin mishshum yichud. afillu ish sheisko umelachto im hannashim asur lo lehityached im hannashim. ketzad yaase. yitassek immahen veishto immo o yifne limlacha acheret: 
Muttar lehityached im shete yevamot. o im shete tzarot. o im ishsha vachamotah. o im ishsha uvat balah. o im ishsha uvat chamotah. mippene shessonot zo et zo veen mechappot zo al zo. vechen muttar lehityached im ishsha sheyyesh immah tinoket ketanna sheyyodaat taam bia veenah moseret atzmah levia. sheenah mezanna befaneha shehare zo megalla et sodah: 
Tinoket mibbat shalosh ulematta vetinok ben tesha ulematta muttar lehityached immahen. shello gazru ella al yichud ishsha haruya levia veish harauy levia: 
Anderoginus eno mityached im hannashim. veim nityached en makkin oto mippene shehu safek. aval haish mityached im haanderoginus veim hattumtum: 
Eshet ish shehaya balah bair enah chosheshet leyichud. mippene sheemat balah aleha. veim haya ze gas bah kegon sheggadla immo o shehayta kerovato lo yityached immah veaf al pi shebbalah bair. vechen kol hammityached im ishsha vehaya happetach patuach lirshut harabbim en choshshin mishshum yichud: 
Mi sheen lo ishsha lo yelammed tinokot. mippene sheimmot habbanim baot levet hassefer livnehem venimtza mitgare benashim. vechen ishsha lo telammed ketannim mippene avotehen shehen bain biglal benehem venimtzeu mityachadim immah. veen hamelammed tzarich shettihye ishto sheruya immo bevet hassefer ella hi bevetah vehu melammed bimkomo: 
Tikkenu chachamim shettihyena hannashim mesapperot zo im zo bevet hakkisse kede shello yikkanes sham ish mishshum yichud: 
En memannin afillu adam neeman vechasher lihyot shomer chatzer sheyyesh sham nashim af al pi shehu omed bachutz sheen appotroppos laarayot. veasur leadam lemannot appotroppos al beto shello yanhig ishto lidvar avera: 
Asur letalmid chacham lishkon bechatzer sheyyesh bah almana af al pi sheeno mityached immah mippene hachashad. ella im ken hayta ishto immo. vechen almana asura legaddel kelev mippene hachashad. velo tikne ishsha avadim zecharim afillu ketannim mippene hachashad: 
En dorshin besitre arayot bishlosha mippene shehaechad tarud bishelat harav vehashshenayim nosin venotnin ze im ze veen datam penuya lishmoa. sheddato shel adam kerova etzel arayot. im nistappek lo davar sheshshama more lehakel. lefichach en dorshin ella lishnayim kede sheyyihye haechad hashshomea mefanne dato veyodea ma sheyyishma min harav: 
En lecha davar bechol hattora kullah shehu kashe lerov haam lifrosh ella min haarayot vehabbiot haasurot. amru chachamim beshaa shennitztauu yisrael al haarayot bachu vekibbelu mitzva zo betaromot uvechiyya shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 11 10)</small> "boche lemishpechotav" al iske mishpachot: 
Veamru chachamim gezel vaarayot nafsho shel adam mitavva lahen umechammedatan. veen atta motze kahal bechol zeman uzeman sheen bahen perutzin baarayot uviot asurot. [veod] amru chachamim rov begezel miut baarayot vehakkol baavak lashon hara: 
Lefichach rauy lo leadam lachof yitzro bedavar ze ulehargil atzmo bikdushsha yetera uvemachashava tehora uvedea nechona kede lehinnatzel mehen. veyizzaher min hayyichud shehu haggorem haggadol. gedole hachachamim hayu omrim letalmidehem hizzaharu bi mippene bitti hizzaharu bi mippene kallati. kede lelammed letalmidehem shello yitbayyeshu middavar ze veyitrachaku min hayyichud: 
Vechen yinhog lehitrachek min hassechok umin hashshichrut umiddivre agavim sheellu gormin gedolim vehem maalot shel arayot. velo yeshev belo ishsha shemminhag ze gorem letohora yetera. gedola mikkol zot amru yafne atzmo umachashavto ledivre tora veyarchiv dato bachachma sheen machshevet arayot mitgabberet ella belev panuy min hachachma. uvachachma hu omer <small>(Mishlei 5 19)</small> "ayyelet ahavim veyaalat chen daddeha yeravvecha vechol et beahavatah tishge tamid":
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Foods 1:
Mitzvat ase leda hassimanin shemmavdilin bahen ben behema vechayya veof vedagim vachagavim shemmuttar leachlan uven sheen muttar leachlan shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 20 25)</small> "vehivdaltem ben habbehema hattehora lattemea uven haof hattame lattahor". veneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 47)</small> "lehavedil ben hattame uven hattahor uven hachayya hanneechelet uven hachayya asher lo teachel": 
Simane behema vechayya nitparshu battora vehem shene simanin <small>(Vayikra 11 3)</small> <small>(Devarim 14 6)</small> "mafreset parsa" u <small>(Vayikra 11 3)</small> <small>(Devarim 14 6)</small> "maalat gera" ad sheyyihyu shenehem. vechol behema vechayya shehi maalat gera en lah shinnayim ballechi haelyon. vechol behema shehi maalat gera hare hi mafreset parsa. chutz min haggamal. vechol behema shehi mafreset parsa hi maalat gera chutz min hachazir: 
Lefichach hammotze behema bammidbar veeno makkirah umetzaah chatuchat happerasot bodek befiha im en lah shinnayim lemala beyadua shehi tehora. vehu sheyyakkir gamal. matza behema sheppiha chatuch bodek befarsoteha im hi shesua tehora. vehu sheyyakkir chazir. matza piha chatuch veragleha chatuchot bodek bah achar sheshshechatah bechanfe haoketz im matza besarah sham mahalach sheti vaerev tehora. vehu sheyyakkir arod shekken hu besaro sheti vaerev: 
Behema tehora sheyyalda kemin behema temea af al pi sheeno mafris parsa velo maale gera ella kemin sus o chamor lechol davar hare ze muttar baachila. bamme devarim amurim besheyyalda lefanav. aval im hinniach para meubberet beedro uva umatza kemin chazir karuch achareha af al pi shehu yonek mimmenna hare ze safek veasur baachila. shemma min hattuma nolad venichrach achar hattehora: 
Behema temea sheyyalda kemin behema tehora af al pi shehu mafris parsa umaale gera vahare hu kemin shor lechol davar o kemin se hare ze asur baachila. shehaggadel min hattemea tame umin hattehora tahor. (lefichach) dag tame shennimtza bime dag tahor asur. vedag tahor hannimtza bime dag tame muttar lefi sheen giddulav ella belao: 
Behema tehora sheyyalda o shennimtza bah beriyya sheyyesh lah shete gabbin ushete shedarot asura baachila. vezo hi hashshesua shenneesra battora shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 7)</small> "et ze lo tochlu mimmaale haggera umimmafrise happarsa hashshesua" kelomar beriyya shennolda shesua lishte behemot: 
Vechen behema shennimtza bah demut of af al pi shehu of tahor hare ze asur baachila. lo huttar min hannimtza babbehema ella ma sheyyesh lo parsa: 
En lecha bechol behema vechayya shebbaolam shemmuttar baachila chutz measeret hamminin hammenuyin battora. shelosha mine behema vehem. shor se veez. veshiva mine chayya. ayyal utzevi veyachmur veakko vedishon uteo vazamer. hem uminehen kegon shor habbar vehammeri shehen mimmin hashshor. vechol haasara minin uminehem maale gera umafris parsa. lefichach mi shehu makkiran eno tzarich livdok lo bappe velo baraglayim: 
Af al pi shekkullan muttarin baachila tzerichin anu lehavedil ben behema tehora vechayya tehora. shehachayya chelbah muttar vedamah taun kissuy vehabbehema hattehora chelbah becharet veen damah taun kissuy: 
Vesimane chayya mippi hashshemua hen. kol min shehu mafris parsa umaale gera veyesh lo karnayim mefutztzalot kegon haayyal hare ze chayya tehora bevadday. vechol sheen karnav mefutztzalot im hayu karnav keruchot kekarne hashshor vacharukot kekarne haez veyihye hecharak muvla bahen vahadurot kekarne hatztzevi hare zo chayya tehora. uvilvad sheyyihye bakkarnayim shelosha simanin ellu keruchot charukot vahadurot: 
Bamme devarim amurim bemin sheeno makkiro aval shiva mine chayya haamurin battora im haya makkir otan afillu lo matza lo karnayim hare ze ochel chelbo vechayyav lechassot damo: 
Shor habbar min behema hu vehakkeresh af al pi sheen lo ella keren achat hare hu chayya. vechol sheyyistappek lecha im hu min chayya o min behema chelbo asur veen lokin alav umechassin et damo: 
Kilayim habba mibbehema tehora im chayya tehora hu hannikra kevi. chelbo asur veen lokin alav umechassin et damo. veen min tame mitabber mimmin tahor kelal: 
Simane of tahor lo nitparesh min hattora. ella mana minyan temeim bilvad ushear mine haof muttarin. vehamminyan haasurin arbaa veesrim hen. veellu hen. 1) nesher. 2) peres. 3) azniyya. 4) daa vehi haraa haamura bemishne tora. 5) ayya vehi haddayyah haamura bemishne tora. 6) min haayya shekken katuv bah leminah michlal shehu shene minin. 7) orev. 8) zarzir shekken neemar beorev lemino lehavi et hazzarzir. 9) yaana. 10) tachmas. 11) shachaf. 12) netz. 13) vesharneka vehu min hannetz shekken katuv bo leminehu. yad) kos. 15) shalach. 16) yanshuf. 17) tinshemet. 18) kaat. 19) rachama. 20) chasida. ka) haanafa. 22) min haanafa shekken neemar bah leminah. 23) hadduchifat. kad) haatallef: 
Kol mi shehu baki beminin ellu uvishmotehen hare ze ochel of sheeno mehem veeno tzarich bedika. veof tahor neechal bemasoret. vehu sheyyihye davar pashut beoto makom shezze of tahor. veneeman tzayyad lomar of ze hittir li rabbi hatztzayyad. vehu sheyyuchzak oto tzayyad shehu baki beminin ellu uvishmotehen: 
Mi sheeno makkiran veeno yodea shemotehen bodek besimanin ellu shennatnu chachamim. kol of shehu dores veochel beyadua shehu meellu hamminin vetame. vesheeno dores veochel im yesh bo echad mishshelosha simanin ellu hare ze of tahor. veellu hen. etzba yetera. o zefek vehi hammura. o shehaya kurkevano niklaf beyad: 
Lefi sheen bechol ellu hamminin haasurin min sheeno dores veyesh bo echad mishshelosha simanin ellu chutz mipperes veazniyya uferes veazniyya enan metzuyin beyishshuv ella bemidbarot iyye hayyam harchokot ad meod shehen sof hayyishshuv: 
Haya hakkurkevan niklaf besakkin veeno niklaf beyad veen bo siman acher af al pi sheeno dores hare ze safek. haya chazak vedavek vehinnicho bashshemesh venitrappa veniklaf beyad hare ze muttar: 
Amru haggeonim shemmasoret hi bidehem sheen morin lehattir of habba besiman echad ella im haya oto siman sheyyikkalef kurkevano beyad. aval im eno niklaf beyad af al pi sheyyesh lo zefek o etzba yetera meolam lo hittiruhu: 
Kol of shecholek et raglav keshemmotchin lo chut shetayim lechan ushetayim lechan. o shekkolet min haavir veochel baavir. hare ze dores vetame. vechol hashshochen im hattemeim venidme lahem hare ze tame: 
Umine chagavim shehittira tora shemona. veellu hen. 1) chagav. 2) min chagav vehu harazvanit. 3) chargol. 4) umin chargol vehu artzuveya. 5) arbe. 6) umin arbe vehi tzipporet keramim. 7) salam. 8) umin salam vehi yochana yerushalmit: 
Mi shehu baki bahen uvishmotehen ochel. vehatztzayyad neeman alehen keof. vmi sheeno baki bahen bodek besimanin. ushelosha simanin yesh bahen. kol sheyyesh lo arba raglayim. vearba kenafayim shechofot rov orech gufo verov hekkef gufo. veyesh lo shene keraayim lenatter bahem hare ze min tahor. veaf al pi sherosho aroch veyesh lo zanav im haya shemo chagav tahor: 
Mi sheen lo achshav kenafayim o keraayim o sheen lo kenafayim hachofin et rubbo veatid legaddel otan achar zeman kesheyyagdil hare ze muttar meatta: 
Uvedagim shene simanin. senappir vekaskeset. usenappir hu shepporeach bo. vekaskeset hi haddevuka bechol gufo. vechol sheyyesh lo kaskeset yesh lo senappir. en lo achshav uchesheyyagdil yihye lo o sheyyesh lo kaskeset keshehu bayyam uchesheyyaale yashshir kaskassav hare ze muttar. umi sheen lo kaskassim hachofin et kullo muttar. afillu en bo ella senappir achat vekaskeset achat hare ze muttar:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Foods 2:
Mikkelal shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 6)</small> "vechol behema mafreset parsa veshosaat shesa shete ferasot maalat gera" shomea ani shekkol sheenah maalat gera umafreset parsa asura. velav habba mikkelal ase ase hu. uvegamal uvachazir uvearnevet uveshafan neemar <small>(Vayikra 11 4)</small> <small>(Devarim 14 7)</small> "et ze lo tochlu mimmaale haggera umimmafrise happarsa" vegomer hare lamadta shehen belo taase veaf al pi sheyyesh bahen siman echad. vechol shekken shear behema temea vechayya temea sheen bah siman kelal sheissur achilatam belo taase yeter al ase habba mikkelal otah tochlu: 
Lefichach kol haochel mibbesar behema vechayya temea kezayit loke min hattora. ben sheachal min habbasar ben sheachal min hachelev. lo chillek hakkatuv bitmeim ben besaram lechelbam: 
Haadam af al pi shenneemar bo <small>(Bereshit 2 7)</small> "vayhi haadam lenefesh chayya" eno mikkelal mine chayya baalat parsa lefichach eno belo taase. vehaochel mibbesar haadam o mechelbo ben min hachay ben min hammet eno loke. aval asur hu baase shehare mana hakkatuv shivat mine chayya veamar bahen <small>(Vayikra 11 2)</small> "zot hachayya asher tochlu" ha kol shehu chutz mehen lo tochlu velav habba mikkelal ase ase: 
Haochel kezayit mibbesar of tame loke min hattora shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 13)</small> "veet elle teshakketzu min haof lo yeachlu". vahare avar al ase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 11)</small> "kol tzippor tehora tochelu" ha temea lo tochlu. vechen haochel kezayit middag tame loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 11)</small> "vesheketz yihyu lachem" <small>(Vayikra 11 11)</small> "mibbesaram lo tochelu". veavar al ase shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 9)</small> "kl asher lo senappir vekaskeset tochelu" mikkelal shemmi sheen lo senappir vekaskeset lo yeachel. ha lamadta shekkol haochel dag tame o behema vechayya temea o of tame bittel mitzvat ase veavar al lo taase: 
Chagav tame hare hu bichlal sheretz haof vehaochel kezayit mishsheretz haof loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 19)</small> "kol sheretz haof tame hu lachem lo yeachelu". vee zehu sheretz haof kegon zevuv o yattush vetzira udevora vechayyotze bahen: 
Haochel kezayit mishsheretz haaretz loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 41)</small> "vechol hashsheretz hashshoretz al haaretz sheketz hu lo yeachel". vee zehu sheretz haaretz kegon nechashim veakrabbim vechifshit venaddal vechayyotze bahen: 
Ushemona sheratzim haamurim battora shehen <small>(Vayikra 11 29)</small> "hachled vehaachbar vehatztzav" <small>(Vayikra 11 30)</small> "vehaanaka vehakkoach vehalletaa vehachomet vehattinshemet" haochel mibbesaram kaadasha loke. shiur achilatan keshiur tumatan. vechullam mitztarfin ze im ze bechaadasha: 
Bamme devarim amurim besheachal mehen achar mitatan. aval hachotech evar min hachay min echad mehen vaachalo eno loke alav ad sheyyihye bo kezayit basar. vechullan mitztarfin lichzayit. achal evar shalem min hashsheretz achar shemmet eno loke ad sheyyihye bo kaadasha: 
Dam shemona sheratzim uvesaran mitztaref lechaadasha vehu sheyyihye haddam mechubbar labbasar. vechen dam hannachash mitztaref livsaro lichzayit veloke alav lefi sheen besaro chaluk middamo. veaf al pi sheeno metamme. vechen kol kayyotze bo mishshear sheratzim sheenan metammein: 
Dam sheratzim shepparash uchenaso vaachalo loke alav bichzayit. vehu sheyyatru bo mishshum ochel sheretz. aval im hitru bo mishshum ochel dam patur. sheen chayyavin ella al dam behema chayya veof: 
Kol hashshiurin umachlekotam halacha lemoshe missinay: 
Haochel kezayit mishsheretz hammayim loke min hattora shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 43)</small> "al teshakketzu et nafshotechem bechol hashsheretz hashshoretz velo tittammeu bahem". hare kalal belav ze sheretz haaretz vesheretz haof vesheretz hammayim. e zehu sheretz hammayim ellu habberiyyot hakketannot kemo hattolaim vehaaluka shebbammayim vehabberiyyot haggedolot beyoter shehen chayyot hayyam. kelalo shel davar kol sheeno betzurat haddagim lo dag tame velo dag tahor kegon kelev hammayim vehaddalfon vehatztzefardea vechayyotze bahen: 
Ellu hamminin shennivrain beashpot uvegufe hannevelot kegon rimma vetolaat vechayyotze bahen sheenan nivrain mizzachar unekeva ella min haggelalim shehisrichu vechayyotze bahen hen hannikrain romes al haaretz. vehaochel mehen kezayit loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 44)</small> "velo tetammeu et nafshotechem bechol hashsheretz haromes al haaretz" veaf al pi sheen parin veravin. aval <small>(Vayikra 11 41 42)</small> "hashsheretz hashshoretz al haaretz" hu sheppare verave mizzachar unekeva: 
Ellu hamminin hannivrain beferot uvemaachalot im parshu veyatzu laaretz af al pi shechazru letoch haochel mi sheachal mehen kezayit loke shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 42)</small> "lechol hashsheretz hashshoretz al haaretz" leesor ellu shepparshu laaretz. aval im lo parshu muttar leechol happeri vehattolaat shebbetocho: 
Bamme devarim amurim shehitlia haochel achar shenneekar min haaretz. aval im hitlia vehu mechubbar. otah hattolaat asura keillu persha laaretz sheal haaretz nivret velokin aleha. veim safek asura. lefichach kol mine perot sheddarkan lehatelia keshehen mechubbarin lo yochal ad sheyyivdok happeri mittocho shemma yesh bo tolaat. veim shaha happeri achar shenneekar shenem asar chodesh ochel belo bedika sheen tolaat shebbo mitkayyemet shenem asar chodesh: 
Parshu laavir velo nagu laaretz. o shepparshu miktzatan laaretz. o shepparshu achar shemmetu. o shennimtzet tolaat al haggarina mibbifnim. o sheyyatzu mittoch haochel letoch ochel acher. kol ellu asurin missafek veen lokin alehen: 
Tolaat hannimtzet bime haddagim uvammoach shebberosh habbehema vehannimtzet babbasar asura. aval dag maliach shehitlia hare hattolaat shebbo mutteret. shehen keferot shehitliu achar shenneekru min haaretz shemmuttar leachlan kullan keachat battolaat shebbetochan. vechen hammayim shebbakkelim shehishritzu hare otan sheratzim muttar lishtotan im hammayim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 9)</small> "vechol asher lo senappir vekaskeset bammayim bayyammim uvannechalim otam tochelu". kelomar bammayim uvayyammim uvannechalim hu sheatta ochel et sheyyesh lo veen atta ochel et sheen lo. aval bechelim ben sheyyesh lo ben sheen lo muttar: 
Sheretz hammayim hannivra bevorot uveshichin uvimarot hoil veenan mayim novin vahare hen atzurim hare hen kemayim shebbechelim umuttar. veshoche veshote veeno nimna veaf al pi shebbolea bishat shetiyya meotan hashsheratzim haddakkim: 
Bamme devarim amurim shello parshu mimmekom beriyyatan. aval im perash hashsheretz af al pi shechazar letoch hakkeli o letoch habbor asur. parash ledafne hechavit vechazar venafal letoch hammayim o letoch hashshechar muttar. vechen im parash ledafne habbor o hammeara vechazar lammayim muttar: 
Hamesannen et hayyayin o et hachometz o et hashshechar veachal et hayyavchushim o et hayyattushin vehattolaot shessinnen loke mishshum sheretz hammayim o mishshum sheretz haof (vesheretz hammayim) afillu chazar lakkeli achar shessinnenan shehare parshu mimmekom beriyyatan. aval im lo sinnenan shote veeno nimna kemo shepperashnu: 
Ze sheamarnu beferek ze haochel kezayit. kesheachal kezayit mibberiyya gedola o shetztzeref meat mibberiyya zo umeat mibberiyya zo shebbeminah ad sheyyochal kezayit. aval haochel beriyya temea bifne atzmah kullah hare ze loke min hattora. vaafillu hayta pechuta min hachardal. ben sheachalah meta ben sheachalah chayya. vaafillu sarcha habberiyya venishtannet tzuratah hoil vaachalah kullah loke: 
Nemala shechasera afillu achat meragleha eno loke aleha ella bichzayit. lefichach haochel zevuv shalem o yattush shalem ben chay uven met loke mishshum sheretz haof: 
Hare shehayta habberiyya mishsheretz haof umishsheretz hammayim umishsheretz haaretz kegon shehayu lah kenafayim vehi mehallechet al haaretz kishar sheratzim vehayta rava bammayim vaachalah loke shalosh malkiyyot. veim hayta yeter al ze min hamminin shennivreu beferot loke aleha arba malkiyyot. veim hayta min hamminin shepparin veravin loke chamesh. veim hayta mikkelal of tame yeter al heyotah mishsheretz haof loke aleha shesh malkiyyot. mishshum of tame. umishshum sheretz haof. umishshum sheretz haaretz. umishshum sheretz hammayim. umishshum romes al haaretz. umishshum tolaat happerot. ben sheachalah kullah ben sheachal mimmenna kezayit. lefichach haochel nemala happorachat haggedela bammayim loke chamesh malkiyyot: 
Rissek nemalim vehevi achat shelema vetzerfah leellu shennitrasseku venaasa hakkol kezayit vaachalo loke shesh malkiyyot. chamesh mishshum hannemala haachat veachat mishshum kezayit minnivlat hattemeim:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Foods 3:
Kol maachol hayyotze mimmin min hamminin haasurin shellokin al achilatan hare oto hammaachol asur baachila min hattora. kegon chalev behema vechayya hattemeim uvetze of vedag hattemeim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 16)</small> <small>(Devarim 14 15)</small> "veet bat hayyaana" zo betzatah. vehu haddin lechol haasur keyaana ulechol haddevarim haddomin levetza: 
Chalev haadam muttar baachila af al pi shebbesar haadam asur baachila. uchevar bearnu shehu baase: 
Devash devorim udevash tzeraim muttar mippene sheeno mittamtzit gufan ella konsin oto min haasavim betoch pihen umekiin oto bakkavveret kede sheyyimtzeu oto leechol mimmennu bimot haggeshamim: 
Af al pi shechalev adam muttar asru chachamim legadol linok oto min hashshadayim ella cholevet ishsha letoch hakkeli veshote. vegadol sheyyanak min hashshad keyonek sheretz umakkin oto makkat mardut: 
Yonek tinok veholech afillu arba o chamesh shanim. veim gemaluhu ufarash shelosha yamim o yeter mechamat buryo lo mechamat chalyo eno chozer veyonek. vehu sheggemaluhu achar 24 chodesh. aval betoch zeman ze afillu gemaluhu chodesh o shenayim muttar lachazor velinok ad sof 24 chodesh: 
Af al pi shechalev behema temea uvetze of tame asurin min hattora en lokin alehem shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 11 8)</small> <small>(Devarim 14 8)</small> "mibbesaram lo tochelu" al habbasar hu loke veeno loke. al habbetza veal hechalav. vahare haochel otan keochel chatzi shiur shehu asur min hattora veeno loke aval makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Yerae li shehaochel betze dagim temeim hannimtzaim bimehem keochel kirve dagim temeim veloke min hattora. vechen betze haof hattame hatteluyot beeshkol sheadayin lo parshu venigmeru. haochel otan loke keochel bene meayim shellahen: 
Betzat of tame shehitchil haefroach lehitrakkem bah vaachalo loke mishshum ochel sheretz haof. aval betzat haof tahor shehitchil haefroach lehitrakkem bah vaachalah makkin oto makkat mardut: 
Nimtza aleha koret dam. im al hachelbon zorek et haddam veochel et hashshear. veim al hachelmon asura kullah. betza hammuzeret hannefesh hayyafa tochlenna: 
Efroach shennolad af al pi shello nitpattechu enav muttar leachlo. behema tehora shennitrefa chalavah asur kachalev behema temea. vechen betzat of tahor shennitraf kevetzat of tame veasur: 
Efroach shennolad mibbetzat terefa muttar sheen mino tame. haya haof sefek terefa kol habbetzim shetteled baarema rishona mashhin otan. im taana arema sheniyya vehitchila leled hutteru harishonot sheim hayta terefa lo hayta yoledet od. veim lo yalda hare hen asurot: 
Chalev behema temea eno nikpe veomed kachalev hattehora. veim nitarev chalev temea bachalev behema tehora keshettaamid oto yaamod chalev hattehora veyetze chalev hattuma im hakkom shel gevina: 
Umippene ze yitten haddin shekkol chalav hannimtza beyad akkum asur shemma erev bo chalev behema temea. ugevinat haakkum mutteret sheen chalev behema temea mitgabben. aval bime chachme mishna gazru al gevinat haakkum vaasarum mippene shemmaamidin otah beor keva shel shechitatan shehi nevela. veim tomar vahalo or hakkeva davar katan hu ad meod bechalav sheamad bo velamma lo yibbatel bemiuto. mippene shehu hammaamid haggevina. vehoil vedavar haasur hu sheheemid hare hakkol asur kemo sheyyitbaer: 
Gevina shemmaamidin otah haakkum baasavim o beme perot kegon seraf hatteenim vahare hen nikkarin baggevina horu miktzat haggeonim shehi asura. shekkevar gazru al kol gevinat haakkum ben sheheemiduha bedavar asur ben sheheemiduha bedavar hammuttar gezera mishshum shemmaamidin otah bedavar haasur: 
Haochel gevinat haakkum o chalav shechalavo akkum veen yisrael roehu makkin oto makkat mardut. hachema shel akkum miktzat haggeonim hittiruha shehare lo gazru al hachema vachalev hattemea eno omed. umiktzat haggeonim asaruha mippene tzichtzuche chalav sheyyishshaer bah. shehare hakkom shebbachema eno meorav im hachema kede sheyyibbatel bemiuto. vechol chalav shellahen choshshin lo shemma ervu bo chalev behema temea: 
Yerae li sheim lakach chema min haakkum uvishshelah ad shehalchu lahen tzichtzuche chalav hare zo mutteret. sheim tomar nitarvu imman venitbashshelu kullan batlu bemiutam. aval hachema shebbishshelu otah akkum asura mishshum giule akkum kemo sheyyitbaer: 
Yisrael sheyyashav betzad haeder shel nachri uva hannachri vehevi lo chalav min haeder af al pi sheyyesh baeder behema temea hare zo muttar. veaf al pi shello raa oto cholev. vehu sheyyachol liroto keshehu cholev kesheyyaamod. shehannachri mityare lachalov min hattemea shemma yaamod veyire oto: 
Betza sheshshene rasheha kaddin o sheshshene rasheha chaddin. o shehaya chelmon mibbachutz vechelbon mibbifnim beyadua shehu betzat of tame. roshah echad kad veroshah echad chad vechelbon mibbachutz vechelmon mibbifnim. efshar shehi betzat of tame veefshar shehi betzat of tahor. lefichach shoel latztzayyad yisrael shemmochrah. im amar lo shel of peloni hu veof tahor hu somech alav. veim amar shel of tahor velo amar lo shemo eno somech alav: 
Lefichach en lokchim betzim min haakkum ella im haya makkir otan veyesh lo bahen teviut ayin shehen betze of peloni hattahor. veen choshshin lahen shemma hen betze terefa o betze nevela. veen lokchin min haakkum betza terufa kelal: 
Betze dagim simanehem kesimane betze haof. im hayu shene rasheha kaddin o chaddin temea. echad kad veechad chad shoel leyisreeli hammocher. im amar lo ani melachtim vehotzetim middag tahor ochel al piv. veim amar lo tehorin hem eno neeman ella im ken haya adam shehuchzak bechashrut: 
Vechen en lokchin gevina vachatichat dag sheen bah siman ella miyyisreeli shehuchzak bechashrut. aval beeretz yisrael keshehayta rubbah yisrael lokchin mikkol yisreeli shebbah. vehechalav lokchin oto mikkol yisrael mikkol makom: 
Hakkovesh dagim temeim tziran asur. aval tzir chagavim temeim muttar mippene sheen bahem lachluchit. lefichach en lokchin tzir min haakkum ella im ken haya bo dag tahor meshotet bo afillu dag echad: 
Akkum shehevi areva melea chaviyyot petuchot shel tzir vedag echad tahor beachat mehem kullan muttarot. hayu setumot patach achat venimtza bah dag tahor sheniyya venimtza bah tahor kullan muttarot. vehu sheyyihye rosho shel dag ushedero kayyam kede sheyyehe nikkar shehu dag tahor. lefichach en lokchin dagim merotzatzin meluchin min haakkum vehem hannikraim tarit terufa. veim haya rosh haddag ushedero nikkar af al pi shehu merotzatz muttar likkach oto min haakkum: 
Akkum shehevi garav shel chatichot dag shechittuchan shave vehen nikkarin shekkullan middag echad umatza bachaticha achat mehen kaskassin hare kullan muttarot:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Foods 4:
Haochel kezayit mibbesar behema shemmeta o chayya shemmeta o of shemmet loke shenneemar <small>(Devarim 14 21)</small> "lo tochlu chol nevela". vechol shello nishchata karauy hare zo meta. uvehilchot hashshechita yitbaer hashshechita shehi karauy vesheenah karauy: 
En asur mishshum nevela ella minim tehorim bilvad mippene shehen reuyin lishchita veim nishchatu shechita keshera yihyu muttarin baachila. aval minin temein sheen shechita moelet bahen ben shennishchata karauy ben shemmeta kedarkah ben shechatach basar min hachay mimmenna vaachalo eno loke mishshum nevela uterefa ella mishshum ochel besar temea: 
Haochel of tahor chay kol shehu loke mishshum ochel nevela veaf al pi sheen bo kezayit hoil vaachalo kullo. veim achalo achar shemmet ad sheyyihye bo kezayit. veaf al pi sheen bechullo basar kezayit hoil veyesh bechullo kezayit chayyav alav mishshum nevela: 
Haochel kezayit mibbesar nefel behema tehora loke mishshum ochel nevela. veasur leechol min habbehema shennolda ad lel shemini shekkol shello shaha shemona yamim bivhema hare ze kenefel. veen lokin alav. veim noda lo shekkalu lo chodashav babbeten veachar kach nolad shehen tisha chodashim livhema gassa vachamishsha ledakka hare ze muttar bayyom shennolad: 
Hashshilya sheyyatzat im havvalad asura baachila vehaochlah patur sheenah basar: 
Haochel kezayit mibbesar behema o chayya o of tehorim shennitrefu loke shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 30)</small> "uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu lakkelev tashlichun oto". terefa haamura battora zo shettarfa otah chayyat hayyaar kegon ari venamer vechayyotze bahen. vechen of shettaraf oto of haddores kegon netz vechayyotze bo. veen atta yachol lomar shettarfa otah vehemita otah sheim meta hare hi nevela. uma li meta mechamat atzmah o hikka besayif vehemitah o shevarah ari vehemitah. ha eno medabber ella beshennitrefa velo meta: 
Veim hatterefa shello meta asura yachol im ba zeev vegarar haggedi beraglo o biznavo o beazno veradaf adam vehitztzilo mippiv yihye asur shehare nitraf talmud lomar <small>(Shemot 22 30)</small> "uvasar bassade terefa" vegomer <small>(Shemot 22 30)</small> "lakkelev tashlichun oto". ad sheyyaase otah basar haruya lakkelev. ha lamadta shehatterefa haamura battora hi shettarfa oto chayyat hayyaar veshavra otah venata lamut vaadayin lo meta. af al pi shekkadam ushechatah kodem shettamut hare zo asura mishshum terefa hoil vei efshar shettichye mimmakka zo habbaa aleha: 
Nimtzeta lamed shehattora asra hammeta vehi hannevela. veasra hannota lamut mechamat makkoteha veaf al pi sheadayin lo meta vehi hatterefa. ucheshem shello tachalok bemita ben meta mechamat atzmah ben shennafla vameta ben shechanakah ad shemmeta ben shedderasatta chayya vaharagatta. kach lo tachalok benota lamut ben shetterafatta chayya ushevaratta ben shennafla min haggag venishtabberu rov tzaloteha ben shennafla venitrasseku evareha ben shezzarak bah chetz venakav libbah o reatah ben shebba lah choli mechamat atzmah venakav libbah o reatah o shibber rov tzaloteha vechayyotze bahen. hoil vehi nota lamut mikkol makom hare zo terefa. ben shehaya haggorem bide basar vadam ben shehaya bide shamayim. im ken lamma neemar battora <small>(Shemot 22 30)</small> "terefa". dibber hakkatuv bahove. sheim lo tomar ken lo teaser ella otah shennitrefa bassade aval im nitrefa bechatzer lo teaser. ha lamadta sheen hakkatuv medabber ella bahove: 
Veinyan hakkatuv shehannota lamut mechamat makkoteha vei efshar lah lichyot mechamat makka zo asura. mikkan amru chachamim ze hakkelal kol sheen kamoha chayya terefa. uvehilchot shechita yitbaer e ze choli ose otah terefa vee ze choli en ose otah terefa: 
Vechen hachotech basar min hachay min hattehorim hare oto habbasar terefa vehaochel mimmennu kezayit loke mishshum ochel terefa. shehare basar ze mibbehema shello nishchata velo meta. ma li tarfa otah chayya ma li chatachah besakkin ma li bechullah ma li bemiktzatah. hare hu omer <small>(Shemot 22 30)</small> "uvasar bassade terefa lo tochelu" kevan shennaaset habbehema basar bassade hare hi terefa: 
Behema shehi chola mechamat shettashash kochah venatta lamut hoil velo era makka beevar meevareha hammemitim otah hare zo mutteret. shello asra tora ella keen terefat chayyat hayyaar shehare asa bah makka hammemita otah: 
Af al pi shehi mutteret gedole hachachamim lo hayu ochlin mibbehema shemmemaharin veshochatin otah kede shello tamut veaf al pi sheppirkesa besof shechita. vedavar ze en bo issur ella kol harotze lehachamir al atzmo bedavar ze hare ze meshubbach: 
Hashshochet behema chayya veof velo yatza mehen dam hare ellu muttarin veen omrin shemma metim hayu. vechen hashshochet et habberia velo pirkesa hare zo mutteret. aval hamesukkenet vehi kol shemmaamidin otah veenah omedet af al pi shehi ochelet maachal beriot im shechatah velo pirkesa kelal hare zo nevela velokin aleha. veim pirkesa hare zo mutteret. vetzarich sheyyihye happirkus besof hashshechita. aval bitchillatah eno moil: 
Ketzad hu happirkus bivhema dakka uvechayya gassa vedakka. ben sheppashta yadah vehechezira o sheppashta raglah af al pi shello hechezira o shekkefafa raglah bilvad hare ze pirkus umuttar. aval im pashta yadah velo hecheziratah hare zo asura sheen zo ella hotzaat nefesh bilvad. uvivhema gassa echad hayyad veechad haregel ben sheppashta velo kaffa ben kaffa velo pashta hare zo pirkus umutteret. veim lo pashta lo yad velo regel velo kaffa kelal hare zo nevela. uveof afillu lo rifref ella beeno velo kishkesh ella biznavo hare ze pirkus: 
Hashshochet et hamesukkenet ballayla velo yada im pirkesa o lo pirkesa hare zo sefek nevela vaasura: 
Kol issurin shebbattora en mitztarfin ze im ze chutz meissure nazir kemo sheyyitbaer sham. lefichach hallokeach meat chelev umeat dam umeat besar behema temea umeat besar nevela umeat besar dag tame umeat besar of tame vechayyotze baellu mishshear haissurin vetzeref min hakkol kezayit vaachalo eno loke vedino kedin ochel chatzi shiur: 
Kol hannevelot mitztarfot zo im zo. unevela mitztarefet im terefa. vechen kol behema vechayya hattemeim mitztarfin ze im ze. aval besar nevela im besar behema temea en mitztarfin. ketzad. hallokeach minnivlat hashshor venivlat hatztzevi venivlat hattarnegol vekibbetz min hakkol kezayit basar vaachalo loke. vechen im kibbetz chatzi zayit minnivlat behema tehora vachatzi zayit min hatterefa o chatzi zayit mibbesar nevela vachatzi zayit mibbasar min hachay min hattehora vaachalo loke. vechen besar haggamal vehachazir vehaarnevet shekkibbetz mikkullam kezayit vaachalo loke. aval im tzeref chatzi zayit minnivlat hashshor vachatzi zayit mibbesar haggamal enan mitztarfin. vechen kol kayyotze baze. vechen behema temea veof tame o dag tame en besar shenehen mitztaref. lefi shehen shene shemot. shehare kol echad mehen belav bifne atzmo kemo shebbearnu. aval kol haofot hattemein mitztarfin kemo shemmitztarfin kol behema vechayya hattemein. ze hakkelal kol sheissuran belav echad mitztarfin. bishne lavin en mitztarfin. chutz minnevela uterefa hoil vehatterefa techillat nevela hi:
